- Iâm looking for more challenging work.

All of the above are valid answers. I think thereâs another perfectly valid answer that candidates seldom mention probably due to the gravity of the interview room situation. Iâve interviewed over a hundred candidates across different companies and am yet to find anyone that mentions: I am not happy with my current salary and benefits compared to my skills

Back to topic of answers. So, when someone answers that they are not learning new things on the job, obviously, youâd be curios to know why and how they have tried to change things. Unfortunately, most candidates simply mention that they are doing repeat work and thereâs not much to learn doing the same thing over and over again. This is where I start feeling a little uneasy. However, I understand that itâs a true statement. If youâre in a similar situation, hereâs some suggestion: read books, and write code based on what youâve read. Then, you can tell a much convincing story that, Iâve forced myself to learn new things and hereâs some proof, but I really want to apply the newly learned skills outside the scope of the âhello worldâ skills.

About work-life balance, I totally hear you. And if your current job doesnât suit what you need out of your life, itâs a perfectly valid reason to look for new opportunities. However, make sure youâre able to clearly set the expectation with your potential employer about what work-life balance means for you. For example, if you canât work over 40 hours a week, or must work from home one-two days a week, itâs best to discuss this even before an interview starts to ensure youâre a good match with the employer.

If you showed up at in interview just because a recruiter got in touch, Iâd say introspect first. Itâs possible that on our subconcious mind you have expectations that the potential of the new job offers you something that you donât get at the current job. So, instead of a passive asnwer that the you simply acted based on the recruiterâs invite, itâs much convincing to see if you can lay down one or two things that you expect from the new job that you donât get at the current job.

About looking for more challenge, it sounds like a cliche unless you can share examples of work that is of challenging to you. May be you like the challenge of using more complicated algorithms, may be you like dealing with a lot of data, may be you like supporting production emergencies, but thereâs gotta be something that you can explicitly mention as challenging. It helps employers to understand if theyâre able to provide you with enough challenge on the job.

Finally, if youâre looking for a new job because the current job isnât paying upto the level of your skills and contributions, make sure to communicate it clearly as well. With salaries and benefits, I find it much easier to work with people that know the actual $ figure thatâll make them happy instead of beating around the bush to create confusions all around. Just be confident and tell what makes you happy. If the employer can afford it, most likely theyâll want to get you onboard as a happy employee. If they canât afford it, theyâll do their best. The key here is to be explicit about what you want and be sure and confident about it.

In a nutshell, when you walk into an interview itâs yours to lose. The potential employer is investing their time and resources and would rather have you hired than having to interview other candidates. As long as you are able to justify why you want the new job, theyâll be quite accommodating.

description:
Tremendous is the global platform built for businesses to send payoutsâgift cards and moneyâto anyone, anywhere, instantly. We're trusted by 20,000+ organizations, from startups to giants like Atlassian, MIT, and United Way, to reach millions of recipients worldwide.

We move billions of dollars through our systems. That makes security existential, and it's why we're making our first dedicated security hire.

About The Role

You'll be our first Head of Security. There's already a real foundation hereâbug bounty, pen tests, automated code and configuration scanning on the production and code side, phishing simulations on the people side. Youâll add to it across access and identity, SecOps and monitoring, incident response, vendor security, employee security practices, and policy. You'll own the whole posture.

This is a player-coach role. Early on, you'll do the scoping and the hands-on work yourself; this is not a role where you direct from above. As the work demands it, we're fully prepared to build a team hereâand we're looking to you to define what that team should be and when.

You'll report to the VP of Engineering , Tremendous' most senior technical leader. We've deliberately placed security with Engineering so you're set up to drive real implementation fastâembedded with the people whose work you're securing, not siloed in a compliance function. As the security function matures, we'll revisit this.

What You'll Do

- Own Tremendous' security posture end-to-end, partnering with our engineering team on production infrastructure and code security. 
- Assess where we have gaps, prioritize them, and tackle our highest-leverage gaps first. Weâll have opinions, but you own the prioritization and implementation. 
- Treat incident response as core, not afterthought. We may not be able to prevent a breach, but your job is making sure it's small, contained, and that we know exactly what to do. 
- Drive security as a cultural shift across the companyâintroducing controls incrementally, working with teams rather than over them. "Yes, and," not "no."
- Lead our AI-security posture. We invest heavily in AI tooling; your job is to manage that risk and enable it, not to ban it. 
- Define when and how to staff up the security function, and hire your own team. 

What You'll Bring

- Real, hands-on security experience at a company that scaledâideally as an early security hire who grew with the business through high growth. 
- Deep experience in at least one core security domainâproduct/production security, security operations, or access/identity and policyâwith enough range to reason across the others. You defined the security posture, not just executed someone elseâs playbook. 
- An engineer's mindset. You reach for code to solve problems and can read our codebase and understand our infrastructure (Ruby on Rails; TypeScript + React; PostgreSQL; Google Cloud). You won't write much day-to-day, but you're not lost in the code. 
- Judgment over checklists. You can explain the actual risk of a given decision, hold a firm line where it matters, and give ground where "best practice" doesn't apply to us or real business need pulls the other way. You can hold your own in a debate about whether to open up broad data access for AI tooling. 
- Bedside manner. You drive hard change by bringing the team around to your point of view, rather than just telling them no. Engineers and the rest of the company want to work with you. 
- Experience building or co-building a small security team is a plus. 
- Fintech, payments, or regulated-industry experience is a plus. 

What's Cool About The Role

- You define the function. First security leader, with the budget for the required tools and team. 
- A real mandate. The push for this hire comes straight from the founders. 
- We invest in your tools. Everyone has a $5k/month budget for AI tools. Use it. 
- Competitive pay and equity. Base salary $250,000â$330,000, plus meaningful equity. 
- Fully remote. Work from anywhere in the Americas. 
- Great culture. Read more about how we work in our public handbook. 

Compensation Range: $250K - $330K

About the role
The Data Analyst Assistant role is central to our current engagement with a Dubai-based investment firm that requires precise data handling and clear visualization. This position provides the quantitative groundwork that allows our principals to form a view on complex corporate governance and strategy questions. We need an assistant who can organize messy data sets into logical structures that reveal the health and performance of a holding company.

About Arabian Private Holdings
Arabian Private Holdings was founded on the principle that many critical business problems do not fit the traditional large-firm consulting model. A board facing a succession question or a family group weighing a capital injection does not need a team of twelve associates and a hundred-page methodology deck. They need experienced partners who can sit with a problem, form a rigorous view, and defend it. We take on a limited number of mandates to ensure that every client receives direct attention from the principals who are actually accountable for the outcome. Our work covers corporate strategy, governance, and operating model efficiency for some of the most significant family groups, listed corporations, and government entities in the region. We focus on clarity over complexity. We operate as a remote firm, choosing to prioritize the quality of our analysis and the strength of our relationships over traditional office overhead or aggressive growth targets.

What you will do - Collect and organize financial and operational data from various portfolio companies for a Dubai-based investment.
- Clean and validate data sets to ensure accuracy before they are used in client presentations.
- Build simple, effective spreadsheets that track performance indicators for large holding companies.
- Assist in drafting reports that translate numbers into clear written arguments for our principals.
- Monitor industry trends and perform basic market research to support ongoing strategic mandates.
- Maintain internal records to ensure that historical client data is easily accessible and correctly categorized.
- Prepare charts and graphs that simplify complex financial structures for board-level reviews.
- Support the audit of corporate governance documents by cross-referencing quantitative findings with qualitative reports.

What we are looking for - A clear understanding of basic statistics and a logical approach to problem-solving.
- Proficiency in spreadsheet software with an ability to manage large amounts of information without errors.
- Strong written skills and the ability to explain what a set of numbers means in plain English.
- Curiosity about how large corporations and family groups operate in different sectors.
- Precision in your work, where you check your own calculations before submitting them for review.
- A degree or ongoing studies in a quantitative field such as economics, finance, or mathematics.

How we work

title: (Senior) Manager Network Planning Train - Bau- & Jahresplanung (m/w/d)
description:
Bei FlixTrain gestaltest du die Zukunft der Mobilität aktiv mit. Wir bieten dir nicht nur sichere Arbeitsplätze sowie attraktive Zusatzleistungen, sondern auch ein dynamisches, internationales Umfeld, in dem deine Ideen echten Einfluss haben. 

Als Teil unseres schnell wachsenden Travel-Tech-Unternehmens arbeitest du an der Schnittstelle von Infrastruktur, Betrieb und kommerzieller Planung und sorgst dafür, dass unser Netzwerk auch während umfangreicher Bauphasen attraktiv, zuverlässig und wirtschaftlich erfolgreich bleibt. 

Über die Rolle 

- Du unterstützt die Entwicklung und Optimierung des jährlichen Fahrplankonzepts und berücksichtigst dabei die Auswirkungen geplanter Infrastrukturmaßnahmen 

- Die Auswirkungen von Bauprojekten auf das FlixTrain-Netzwerk analysierst du und leitest daraus fundierte Handlungsempfehlungen sowie alternative Konzepte ab 

- Datengetriebene Analysen mit Excel, BI-Tools und ersten KI-Anwendungen helfen dir dabei, kommerzielle Auswirkungen auf Nachfrage, Umsatz und Kosten zu bewerten 

- Gemeinsam mit den Teams aus Commercial Planning, Operations und Betriebsplanung entwickelst du umsetzbare Lösungen für baubedingte Herausforderungen 

- Externe Stakeholder-Termine mit DB InfraGO, der Bundesnetzagentur und weiteren Partnern bereitest du vor und vertrittst dabei die Interessen von FlixTrain 

Über dich 

- Du verfügst über gute Kenntnisse der Verkehrsgeographie in Deutschland und interessierst dich für die Zusammenhänge zwischen Infrastruktur, Betrieb und Wirtschaftlichkeit 

- Analytisches Denken, ein ausgeprägtes Zahlenverständnis sowie sehr gute Excel-Kenntnisse zeichnen dich aus 

- Erste Berufserfahrung im Bereich Network Planning (Netzplanung), Kapazitätsmanagement, Transport, Infrastruktur, Consulting oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld bringst du bereits mit 

- Eine strukturierte, eigenständige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise kombinierst du mit starken Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und Freude an bereichsübergreifender Zusammenarbeit 

- Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (C1-Niveau) sind für dich selbstverständlich 

- Erfahrungen mit KOMBau, FBS, IVU, SQL, Python, BI-Tools oder KI-Anwendungen sind ein Plus aber kein muss 

Bei uns zählt der Blick auf das Ganze - auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen zu 100 % erfüllst, aber dennoch glaubst, etwas bewegen zu können, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung! 

Was Wir Bieten 

- Reisevorteile: 12 kostenlose Flix-Gutscheine + 12 Rabattgutscheine für Freunde & Familie. 

- Arbeiten von Überall: Je nach Rolle kannst du bis zu 60 Tage pro Jahr von einem anderen Standort aus arbeiten. 

- Hybrides Arbeitsmodell: Wir sind ein Unternehmen mit Bürokultur, bieten jedoch Flexibilität, um Arbeit und Leben in Einklang zu bringen. 

- Gesundheits- und Wohlfühlangebote: Zugang zu vertraulichen Einzelberatungen, Kursen und Stressbewältigungsmaßnahmen – für dich und bis zu vier Familienangehörige. 

- Lernen & Entwicklung: Nutze Sprachkurse, Schulungen und Experten-Sessions, um deine Fähigkeiten auszubauen. 

- Mentoring-Programm: Vernetze dich mit erfahrenen Kollegen, um Einblicke zu gewinnen und deine Karriere zu beschleunigen. 

Warum Teil von Flix werden? 

Bei Flix konzentrieren wir uns darauf, Reisen einfach, sicher und erschwinglich zu gestalten – sowohl für unsere Passagiere als auch für unsere Mitarbeiter. Hier geht es schnell voran, und es gibt viel Raum, etwas zu bewegen. Wir wachsen und entwickeln uns täglich weiter und suchen Menschen, die bereit sind, sich einzubringen und die Art und Weise, wie wir arbeiten, mitzugestalten. Wenn du einen Job suchst, in dem du wachsen und etwas bewirken kannst, dann bist du bei FlixTrain genau richtig. Hier kannst du Teil eines Teams werden, in dem dein Beitrag zählt und du deine Reise selbst gestalten kannst!

description:
About Acadia Pharmaceuticals 

Acadia is committed to turning scientific promise into meaningful innovation that makes the difference for underserved neurological and rare disease communities around the world. Our commercial portfolio includes the first and only FDA-approved treatments for Parkinson’s disease psychosis and Rett syndrome. Medical Science Liaison (MSL) for Germany plays a pivotal role in advancing our mission in rare pediatric diseases, with a core focus on Rett syndrome. The MSL drives scientific exchange, supports evidence generation, and helps ensure patients, caregivers, and clinicians have access to high-quality scientific and medical information about Acadia’s therapeutic innovations.

title: Rust Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
Rust Engineer

Location: Remote or Berlin (Office available)

At Deepslate, we are building Speech to Speech Voice AI models that sound and act indistinguishably from a human. And we believe everyone should be able to use them.

With its endless languages, dialects, accents, subtle intonations, and speech melodies, voice remains a highly complex unsolved frontier.

That is exactly why we started Deepslate.

Backed by top-tier investors from the Tech and AI sectors, as well as a major German VC fund, we are incredibly well-funded and moving fast.

We are building the future of communication. 

We aren't trying to build another standalone platform; instead, we are the intelligence engine powering countless other applications. Whether it's integrated as a module by a CRM provider, plugged into another Voice AI platform, or directly embedded into an enterprise system by our integration partners, our model is built to work wherever it is needed.

Your Role

Many core parts of our model stack are written in Rust. At the heart of it is our inference engine, written entirely in Rust.

Your mission is to build and improve these systems. You will work on the inference engine, take ownership of other Rust projects, and help decide how everything fits together. We need someone who enjoys writing good Rust code and can design software that stays understandable and maintainable as it grows.

Our models need to respond in real time. The software you build will directly influence how fast and reliable they are in an actual conversation.

What You'll Do

- Build in Rust: Develop our inference engine and other core components of the model stack. Take projects from the first architectural decisions to running in production.

- Design the Architecture: Decide how components and services communicate, where responsibilities belong, and how we can extend the system without making it harder to work on.

- Work on Real-Time Systems: Build async Rust systems that handle concurrent workloads and streaming audio with low latency.

- Improve Performance: Find bottlenecks, understand what's causing them, and improve latency, throughput, and resource usage.

- Write Production-Ready Code: Build software that we can test, debug, and operate reliably. Help improve our tooling, documentation, and development practices along the way.

What We're Looking For: Must-Haves

- Strong hands-on experience with Rust , including ownership, borrowing, composition, and idiomatic Rust design patterns.

- Solid experience with async Rust . You know how to structure concurrent applications and deal with synchronization, cancellation, and backpressure.

- Experience building and working with microservice architectures .

- A true startup mindset: You are comfortable navigating the glorious chaos of an early-stage codebase. Inconsistent structures, missing docs. You name it, you'll help fix it.

- Drive and Vision: You aren't just looking to blindly process Jira tickets. You want to actively shape the product, architect solutions, and take complete project ownership.

Ideally, You Also Bring

- Knowledge of actor systems and experience using actors to structure concurrent applications.

- Experience with real-time systems , whether in embedded environments or the cloud. Both are relevant to us.

- Experience with C/C++ interoperability , including generating Rust bindings with bindgen .

Nice-to-Haves

- Experience with CUDA or GPU computing .

- Contributions to open-source projects .

- Python knowledge.

- Experience with lower-level performance engineering, such as debugging memory leaks or understanding performance at the machine instruction level.

- German , spoken and written.

What We Offer

- Technical Ownership: Our Rust stack is central to the company. You'll have the trust and freedom to make architectural decisions and see them through.

- True R&D Freedom: We give you the time, resources, and trust to research and build technology that simply doesn't exist yet. There are difficult problems here, and room to try different approaches.

- Competitive Compensation: We are well-funded by top-tier VCs. We offer a highly competitive salary. We are looking for top talent, and we are ready to pay for it.

- Serious Compute: You will have access to the hardware and cloud infrastructure necessary to build, test, and optimize the systems running our models.

- Absolute Flexibility: Fully remote work, asynchronous communication, and zero micromanagement. We care about your output and impact, not your schedule.

Deepslate is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic origin, religion, disability, age, or sexual orientation.

Compensation: €75K – €120K • Offers Equity

title: Product Owner (m/w/d) - Customer Domain
description:
Über uns Seit 2008 arbeiten wir mit unseren vier Marken doctari, lichtfeld, Planerio und arztpool an unserer Vision, medizinisches Personal dorthin zu bringen, wo es am dringendsten benötigt wird. 

doctari pro ist unsere B2B-Buchungsplattform für Personalverantwortliche in Krankenhäusern und Gesundheitseinrichtungen und die zentrale Schnittstelle zur Demand-Seite unseres Marktplatzes. Über doctari pro können Ärztinnen und Ärzte unkompliziert gefunden, angefragt und gebucht werden: in Arbeitnehmerüberlassung oder befristeter Anstellung. Als Gegenstück zur doctari App auf der Kandidatenseite ist doctari pro ein zentraler Bestandteil unseres zweiseitigen Marktplatzes. 

Deine neue Rolle Als Product Owner (m/w/d) im Customer Domain Team übernimmst du Verantwortung für einen der wichtigsten Wachstumshebel unseres Unternehmens. Gemeinsam mit deinem cross-funktionalen Team gestaltest du die Produktstrategie ebenso aktiv mit wie die Umsetzung neuer Features und bringst moderne Technologien wie KI gezielt in die Weiterentwicklung von doctari pro ein. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Engineering, UX Design und internen Stakeholdern zusammen und triffst fundierte Produktentscheidungen auf Basis von Nutzerdaten, technischen Anforderungen und Marktanforderungen. 

- Du verantwortest die Weiterentwicklung von doctari pro und entwickelst gemeinsam mit deinem cross-funktionalen Team innovative Features für Kliniken und Gesundheitseinrichtungen, von der Anfrage bis zur Buchung.

- Du priorisierst das Product Backlog anhand von Kundenbedürfnissen, Marktanforderungen und relevanten Produkt-KPIs.

- Du steuerst den gesamten Produktentwicklungsprozess von der Product Discovery über Delivery bis zum erfolgreichen Release.

- Du arbeitest mit internen Stakeholdern zusammen und übersetzt Marktanforderungen in klare Produktentscheidungen.

- Du analysierst Nutzungs- und Buchungsdaten, leitest Handlungsempfehlungen ab und optimierst kontinuierlich die Customer Journey auf doctari pro.

- Du treibst den gezielten Einsatz von Künstlicher Intelligenz im Produkt voran.

Deine Erfahrung & Persönlichkeit - Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung als Product Owner, Product Manager oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle, idealerweise in einem B2B-SaaS-, Plattform- oder Marketplace-Umfeld.

- Erfahrung in der Entwicklung digitaler Produkte für Geschäftskunden: von der Product Discovery über nutzerzentriertes Design bis zur datengetriebenen Optimierung.

- Technisches Verständnis, das tief genug geht, um Architekturentscheidungen zu verstehen, Trade-offs zu bewerten und mit Engineering auf Augenhöhe zu diskutieren.

- Analytisches Denken, Pragmatismus sowie eine strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise.
- Begeisterung für KI-gestützte Produkte und moderne Technologien, die du aktiv nutzt, um Produktmehrwert zu schaffen.

- Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Sales, Account Management oder Customer Success ist ein klares Plus.

- Sehr gute Deutsch- und fließende Englischkenntnisse runden Dein Profil ab.

Das erwartet Dich Bei uns übernimmst du echte Produktverantwortung für doctari pro, eine Plattform mit direktem Einfluss auf die Versorgungsqualität im deutschen Gesundheitssystem. Du gestaltest die Demand-Seite eines der größten medizinischen Marktplätze Deutschlands mit und siehst die Wirkung deiner Arbeit unmittelbar in den Daten.

title: AI Compiler Engineer
description:
EnCharge AI is a leader in advanced AI hardware and software systems for edge-to-cloud computing. EnCharge’s robust and scalable next-generation in-memory computing technology provides orders-of-magnitude higher compute efficiency and density compared to today’s best-in-class solutions. The high-performance architecture is coupled with seamless software integration and will enable the immense potential of AI to be accessible in power, energy, and space constrained applications. EnCharge AI launched in 2022 and is led by veteran technologists with backgrounds in semiconductor design and AI systems.

About the Role 

EnCharge AI is seeking a highly skilled and experienced AI Compiler Engineer to spearhead the efforts in developing and optimizing graph compilers tailored to cutting-edge AI and ML workloads. You will collaborate with hardware architects, and AI researchers to enhance performance, optimize computation graphs, and enable efficient model deployment on EnCharge’s Inference Accelerators. 

Responsibilities 

Architect, design, and implement optimizations for AI model execution on graph compilers to improve performance, reduce latency, and maximize hardware utilization.

- Work closely with ML researchers, hardware engineers, and software developers to design and deploy AI models, understanding and addressing hardware-specific challenges.

- Work on performance optimizations for neural network models, such as layer fusion, operator fusion, and graph-level transformations.

- Develop compiler optimizations and passes that convert high-level AI models (e.g., from TensorFlow, PyTorch) into intermediate representations (IR).

- Implement parsing, semantic analysis, and IR generation for deep learning frameworks.

- Research and integrate the latest advancements in compiler design, ML model optimizations, and hardware acceleration into graph compilers.

- Provide leadership, mentorship, and technical guidance to a team of engineers focused on graph compiler optimizations. 

Qualifications 

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field (Ph.D. preferred).

- 3+ years in compiler development, with a strong focus on AI or ML graph compilers.

- Proficiency in AI graph compiler frameworks (e.g., MLIR, Torch-FX)

- Solid background in hardware architectures (e.g., GPUs, TPUs, ASICs) and optimization techniques such as fusion, quantization, and tiling.

- Familiarity with neural networks operators and code generation.

- Strong understanding of intermediate representations, code parsing, and semantic analysis in compiler design.

- Proficiency in C++, Python, or other programming languages commonly used in compiler development.

- Open-source contributions to AI software frameworks and libraries is a plus

- Demonstrated experience leading and mentoring engineering teams with successful project delivery. 

EnCharge AI is an equal employment opportunity employer in the United States.

The salary range for this position is $190,000 to $255,000 USD per year. (Per Year: $195,000 to $265,000 CAD | €110,000 to €160,000 EUR | 1,206,458 to 1,754,848 NOK)
Actual compensation offered will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

title: Cloud Platform Engineer (m/w/d)
description:
Ab sofort

Das erwartet dich Wir bauen mit unserem Green-Field-Ansatz eine neue Cloud in unseren deutschen Rechenzentren auf — vollständig selbst gehostet, cloud-native und ohne Abhängigkeit von amerikanischen Hyperscalern. Jeder unserer Kunden erhält ein dediziertes Kubernetes-Cluster auf Basis des SUSE-Stacks (Harvester, RKE2), ausgerollt und verwaltet über Fleet, mit eigenem Tenant-Management.

Du bist nicht Betreiber eines fremden Systems, sondern gestaltest die Plattform, auf der unsere Software als SaaS läuft — mit echter Verantwortung und echtem Gestaltungsspielraum.

Digitale Souveränität ist bei uns kein Versprechen, sondern Betriebsrealität. Auf dieser Plattform laufen die geschäftskritischen Anwendungen von Versicherern und Auftraggebern der öffentlichen Hand. Die Anforderungen an Verfügbarkeit, Informationssicherheit und Nachweisbarkeit sind auf allerhöchsten Level. Hierfür sind unsere Managed Services nach BSI C5 testiert.

Das erwartet dich 

Plattform entwickeln und gestalten 
- Konzeption, Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung der selbst gehosteten Cloud-Plattform (Multi-Cluster, ohne Hyperscaler-Abhängigkeit, volle Kontrolle)
- Architektur und Design hochverfügbarer Kubernetes-Cluster im SUSE-Stack, inklusive Networking, Storage, Load Balancing und Authentifizierung
- Design und Weiterentwicklung des Tenant-Konzepts: isolierte Kundenumgebungen, Verantwortung für Architektur und Lifecycle
- Abstimmung mit der Entwicklung zu performance- und verfügbarkeitsrelevanten Anforderungen an das Cluster- und Tenant-Konzept
- Weiterentwicklung des Hochverfügbarkeitskonzepts: Ein verteilter In-Memory Ansatz über mehrere Knoten (Schwarmtechnik), der die Echtzeitfähigkeit der Anwendungen im Normalbetrieb sicherstellt
Automatisieren und standardisieren 
- GitOps-Workflows über ArgoCD und Fleet — von der Erstauslieferung bis zum Day-2-Betrieb vollständig automatisiert
- Infrastructure as Code mit Ansible, Terraform oder vergleichbaren Tools; Policy as Code für Sicherheit und Governance
- CI/CD-Integration und Standardisierung der Deployment-Prozesse
Brücke zu den Entwicklungsteams und Kunden 
- Platform Engineering für interne Teams: Aufbau von Self-Service-Fähigkeiten, Definition von Standards, Begleitung des Onboardings
- Aktive Unterstützung der Entwicklungsteams bei der Migration ihrer Workloads in die Cloud-Plattform
- Verarbeitung von Erkenntnissen aus dem laufenden Betrieb (Monitoring-Daten, Incidents) zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung von Stabilität, Sicherheit und Performance

Das bringst du mit Must-have 
- Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Cloud- oder Platform-Engineering, in Container-Technologien oder Infrastrukturautomatisierung
- Fundierte Kubernetes Kenntnisse, idealerweise aus dem Betrieb produktiver Multi-Cluster-Umgebungen
- Erfahrung mit GitOps-Workflows (idealerweise ArgoCD oder Fleet) und Infrastructure as Code (z. B. Ansible, Terraform)
- Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse (mind. C1) sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
- Reisebereitschaft für Kundentermine und Termine an unseren weiteren Standorten
Nice-to-have 
- Erfahrung mit SUSE Stack oder vergleichbaren Kubernetes-Management-Plattformen
- Kenntnisse in DevSecOps, Policy as Code oder Hochverfügbarkeitskonzepten
- Erfahrung mit Monitoring-Stacks (z. B. Prometheus, Grafana)
Persönlich 
- Systemisches Denken statt Ticket-Fokus, mit Blick fürs Gesamtbild
- Sicheres Auftreten und Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe mit Entwicklungsteams wie mit Kunden
- Strukturierte, eigenständige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
- Erfahrung darin, Themen über Team- und Kundengrenzen hinweg zu steuern

Was wir dir bieten - Übernimm Verantwortung und nutze deinen Gestaltungsspielraum, um eigene Ideen zu verwirklichen.
- Arbeite dort, wo Wirkung entsteht: im Office oder direkt beim Kunden. Homeoffice ist die Ausnahme – dafür bieten wir dir flexible Arbeitszeiten und ein Office, in dem man gerne arbeitet und den Tag gemeinsam verbringt.
- Profitiere von internen und externen Schulungen, die dich fachlich und persönlich weiterbringen.
- Genieße Benefits wie BusinessBike, EGYM Wellpass, Corporate Benefits und einen Zuschuss für den ÖPNV.
- Neben einem VWL-Zuschuss bieten wir dir eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge und eine Kita-Förderung.
- Ob Surfen, Wandern, Mountainbiken oder Golfen – bei unseren vielseitigen Mitarbeiter-Events ist für jeden etwas dabei!

title: Product Manager – Android Integration & Ecosystem
description:
Your mission As our Product Manager – Android Integration & Ecosystem , you will define the product what and why for how ProGlove devices connect, integrate and create value within the enterprise Android ecosystem.

ProGlove is evolving from a wearable scanner company into a Worker Companion company, bringing together ergonomic wearable hardware, software, connectivity, workflow guidance, data and intelligence. With the MAI Wearable Companion, we are entering a broader ecosystem of enterprise applications, technologies, standards, partners and customer infrastructure.

Your mission will be to make our products easy to adopt, integrate and deploy at scale – without turning every customer opportunity into a bespoke engineering project. You will identify recurring customer needs, translate them into scalable capabilities and propositions, and decide where ProGlove should own, enable or partner. In doing so, you will help turn integration from a technical necessity into a source of differentiation, customer value and commercial opportunity.

You will work closely with the Product Manager responsible for the Wearable Companion device. While they own the device proposition, you will own how the device connects to and creates value in the wider ecosystem. Together, you will shape a coherent end-to-end proposition for customers, developers, integrators and partners.

Your day-to-day 
- Define and evolve the product strategy and priorities for ProGlove’s enterprise Android integration and ecosystem capabilities, aligned with customer needs and business goals.
- Work directly with customers, Sales and Solution Architecture to identify recurring problems, distinguish individual requests from broader market needs and turn the right opportunities into scalable solutions.
- Translate recurring integration needs into repeatable product capabilities such as APIs, SDKs, tools, interfaces, documentation, integration patterns and deployment solutions.
- Shape the product experience around device setup, provisioning, application distribution, device management and other capabilities required to deploy and operate connected device fleets at scale.
- Make clear, pragmatic decisions about where ProGlove should own, enable or partner , balancing customer value, strategic control, speed, scalability and technical complexity.
- Identify the platforms, applications, standards and ecosystem players that matter to our customers, and shape the integrations, certifications and technology partnerships that strengthen our proposition.
- Explore where integration capabilities, software, services and ecosystem propositions can create differentiated value and support commercial or recurring-revenue opportunities.
- Partner closely with Engineering and the Product Manager for the Wearable Companion to create alignment on customer problems, priorities, trade-offs and desired outcomes.
- Enable Sales and other customer-facing teams to clearly explain our Android proposition, supported capabilities, integrations and common deployment patterns.
- Maintain a forward-looking view of enterprise Android, AOSP, enterprise mobility, AI and adjacent technologies, and translate relevant developments into strategic options and product priorities.

Your profile At ProGlove, technical expertise matters, but how you work is just as important. We are looking for someone who takes ownership, stays curious, collaborates openly and turns complexity into clear, pragmatic decisions.

- You bring strong Product Management experience in B2B or enterprise technology and can define strategy, discover meaningful customer problems, prioritize opportunities and turn them into scalable products or propositions.
- You are commercially minded and naturally connect product decisions with customer value, differentiation, business impact and opportunities to capture value.
- You are comfortable working with enterprise software, platforms, connected devices, integrations or technology ecosystems, and understand the realities of complex customer IT environments.
- You have enough technical depth to understand architecture, interfaces and trade-offs, contribute credibly to platform and integration discussions, and recognize when deeper engineering expertise is needed.
- You think in systems and patterns: when faced with a customer requirement, you look beyond the immediate request to understand why it exists, how broadly it applies and what a simple, repeatable solution could look like.
- You take end-to-end ownership, move topics forward without waiting for perfect instructions and remain effective when the product space or path ahead is not yet fully defined.
- You collaborate generously and build trust across Product, Engineering, Sales, Solution Architecture, customers and external partners. You can create alignment and drive decisions without relying on formal authority.
- You communicate clearly and transparently, raise risks early and can make complex technical and commercial topics understandable to different audiences.
- You are curious about customers, the business and emerging technologies, and continuously test assumptions rather than pursuing technology for its own sake.
- You use pragmatic judgment to balance speed, simplicity, quality and long-term value.
- You are fluent in English and comfortable working in an international environment.
Experience in one or more of the following areas would be valuable, but is not required:

- Enterprise Android, AOSP or adjacent Android ecosystems, including environments operating outside standard Google Mobile Services.
- Enterprise mobility management, MDM/EMM, device provisioning, application deployment or connected fleet management.
- Rugged or industrial devices, IoT or edge devices, connected hardware or other B2B technology ecosystems.
- APIs, SDKs, developer or integrator experiences and enterprise integrations.
- Platform or ecosystem strategy, technology partnerships, certification programs or developer and partner ecosystems.
- Enterprise customers deploying technology at scale.
Direct Android Product Management experience is an advantage, but not essential if you bring strong Product Management expertise and relevant experience from an adjacent enterprise technology ecosystem.

Why us? This is an opportunity to shape an important part of a category that is still being defined. 
Android gives ProGlove access to a much broader technology ecosystem, but the opportunity goes far beyond compatibility. You will help determine what role ProGlove should play in that ecosystem, which capabilities we should own, where we should partner, what customers and developers should be able to build around us, and where integration itself can become a source of differentiation and recurring business value. 
ProGlove already has the customer base, market credibility, technology and industrial expertise to build on. Our products are used in some of the world's most demanding operational environments. What we are now building is the next layer. 
Over time, success will mean more than making our own products easier to integrate. It will mean creating capabilities, interfaces and ecosystem relationships that customers, application providers and partners actively choose to build around - moving ProGlove from ecosystem participant toward ecosystem shaper. 
If you are excited by the idea of turning complex technology ecosystems into simple, valuable products - and helping shape how the next generation of frontline technology connects with the digital world - we would love to meet you. 
Join us in building the future of frontline work.

What success looks like - ProGlove has a clear, customer-backed strategy and prioritized roadmap for Android integration and ecosystem capabilities.
- Recurring customer and integration needs are turned into scalable, repeatable solutions rather than one-off engineering projects.
- Customers can adopt, integrate, deploy and manage ProGlove devices more easily within their existing enterprise environments.
- Decisions about what ProGlove should own, enable or partner are made transparently and based on customer value, business impact and long-term scalability.
- Product, Engineering, Sales and Solution Architecture are aligned on priorities, supported capabilities and key trade-offs.
- Customer-facing teams can confidently communicate our Android proposition and common deployment patterns without relying on Product or Engineering in every opportunity.
- Relevant integrations, partnerships and commercial opportunities are identified, validated and translated into tangible product or business outcomes.

Meet your team You will join our Product team and report directly to the CPO. You will work especially closely with the Product Manager responsible for the Wearable Companion, as well as colleagues across Engineering, Sales, Solution Architecture and Product Marketing.

This is a highly cross-functional role. You will bring together customer needs, technical realities and commercial opportunities, while also building relationships with external technology partners, platform providers and integrators. The team values open collaboration, clear communication and shared ownership of outcomes.

title: AI Researcher, LLMs
description:
Hudson River Trading (HRT) is seeking an LLM-focused AI Researcher to join the HAIL team. HAIL (HRT AI Labs) is the team at HRT responsible for developing and maintaining our most powerful AI models, which are used by our trading teams to drive a significant fraction of our trading. The LLM team within HAIL builds large language models from scratch — pretraining, post-training, and serving — that are deployed across the firm to accelerate research, engineering, and trading workflows. Our goal is to produce LLMs that are genuinely best-in-world for the use cases we care about.

In this role, you'll work on every stage of the model development loop: tokenizer training, dataset curation and mixing, pretraining, post-training, evaluation design, inference, and live trading. HAIL researchers have great independence to pursue the directions they think would be most impactful as part of a small, focused team with minimal bureaucracy. They are enabled by state-of-the-art research clusters with very high GPU-to-researcher ratios, and supported by excellent engineering, hardware, and systems teams to realize their vision.

The work is challenging and visibly impactful, and the bar is high: we are not looking for people who will adapt existing recipes. We want people who can drive frontier capability gains and ship the code that gets us there.

Qualifications 

- Two or more years of hands-on experience training, post-training, or evaluating LLMs at scale

- Direct experience with at least one of: large-scale pretraining, post-training (SFT, RL), LLM evaluation design and statistical analysis, or distributed training/inference systems

- Research taste: ability to identify what's worth trying next, design ablations that change decisions, and update beliefs from evidence

- Strong engineering skills valued: GPU kernel development, lower-level PyTorch internals, or published work on a frontier-style LLM result

The estimated base salary range for this position is 200,000 to 300,000 USD per year (or local equivalent). The base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role will also be eligible for discretionary performance-based bonuses and a competitive benefits package. 

Culture 

Hudson River Trading (HRT) brings a scientific approach to trading financial products. We have built one of the world's most sophisticated computing environments for research and development. Our researchers are at the forefront of innovation in the world of algorithmic trading. 

At HRT we welcome a variety of expertise: mathematics and computer science, physics and engineering, media and tech. We’re a community of self-starters who are motivated by the excitement of being at the cutting edge of automation in every part of our organization—from trading, to business operations, to recruiting and beyond. We value openness and transparency, and celebrate great ideas from HRT veterans and new hires alike. At HRT we’re friends and colleagues – whether we are sharing a meal, playing the latest board game, or writing elegant code. We embrace a culture of togetherness that extends far beyond the walls of our office. 

Feel like you belong at HRT? Our goal is to find the best people and bring them together to do great work in a place where everyone is valued. HRT is proud of our diverse staff; we have offices all over the globe and benefit from our varied and unique perspectives. HRT is an equal opportunity employer; so whoever you are we’d love to get to know you. 

Please be advised: Use of AI tools during interviews or assessments is strictly prohibited, unless otherwise instructed or agreed upon. We employ various methods to evaluate the authenticity of candidate responses. If we determine that AI assistance was used during any stage of the hiring process, we reserve the right to immediately disqualify your candidacy or rescind any job offers extended.

Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment, where you gain a tremendous amount of responsibility? Do you want to be part of an exceptional entrepreneurial team with motivated and extremely driven people? Are you curious or passionate about creating events? If so, you might be our SDR.

About us 

Retail Insights is Northern Europe’s leading retail forum. We are strengthening the retail ecosystem by building a platform for insights, inspiration, and networking, connecting more than 3,000 leaders yearly from more than 15 countries.

Retail Insights is part of United Media which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.

What we offer you 

As our SDR, you get the unique opportunity to be a key player in building the greatest global conferences by providing you with exceptional training and products. We want to constantly push you out of your comfort zone. You’ll be working out of our HQ in London and to ensure a never ending growth curve, we provide you with:

- A competitive salary and generous OTE

- An opportunity for getting operational experience in a scale-up business where both your work and the results are highly tangible and matters to the businesses

- A chance to work closely together with our leadership team on conference strategies

- Unlimited growth potential in our group - we strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally

Your Responsibilities 

Your mission would be to work closely with our lead generation and senior sales team to generate meetings for our global partnerships managers. In order to be successful, your main duties will include:

- Meeting booking: Work with a team of analysts to both review potential leads and set up meetings for our sales team. You are expected to use a range of outreach methods (phone, email, LinkedIn etc) in order to set meetings with quality prospects

- Expertise Development: Over time, hone your expertise in generating new business meetings with senior prospects, becoming an essential part of our growth journey

- Sales Collaboration: Work hand-in-hand with our sales representatives, helping them fill their diaries and grow our impressive sponsor roster globally

What we expect from you 

You possess an unparalleled work ethic with a high sense of urgency. You have a relentless drive and desire to be the very best at what you do. You take ownership of everything you do, are proactive and follow through on commitments. Moreover, you’re humble and you share our passion for building and executing new businesses. Furthermore, we expect that you can demonstrate:

- Sales passion: Have a relentless drive and desire to work in an outbound sales role with a view to rapidly progressing your career with us

- Target driven: Have worked in a fast-paced commercial environment and enjoy meeting targets

- Team Spirit: Are curious about people and love to speak, build and nurture relations

- Communication Maestro: Showcase stellar verbal and written communication skills

Startdate 

Flexible, Monday - Friday we work from our office (next to Victoria Station) and do not offer remote work. You must have a UK work permit.

title: Sales Internship at Retail Insights
description:
Are you looking for challenges within an exceptional entrepreneurial team with young, motivated and extremely driven people? If so, now is the time to apply for our Internship Program in London.

Why Retail Insights 

We fundamentally believe our people are our greatest asset. At the company, you will work with incredible entrepreneurs who will push and guide you towards greatness. 

In short, we offer the brightest talents:

- An opportunity to fast-track your career through responsibility for high-impact projects that constantly push you out of your comfort zone.

- A chance to develop exceptional problem-solving, communication, and analytical skills.

- You will use your interests and skills to have real influence—typically quite early in your career—and to solve the problems no one else can solve.

- Hands-on experience building and scaling ventures together with the sharpest minds.

- Networking Opportunities, Expand your professional network and forge meaningful connections with peers, mentors, and industry leaders.

- Mentorship and guidance - A chance to work closely with our high-performing team as well as with the founder of our company, Mads Faurholt.

What roles are available 

You’ll be part of building and scaling companies, which, depending on your talent profile and interests, could entail responsibilities such as:

- Being part of creating connections with key players from the industries we work in, such as CEOs, entrepreneurs, for example, co-founders of Airbnb, Apple, Starbucks etc. building and maintaining valuable relationships with them.

- Drive revenue growth by getting involved in the commercial strategy and execution.

- Expanding our audiences of senior industry professionals, investors, and future unicorn founders by defining and executing marketing strategies.

- Strategically contribute to hyper-growing the team of talented and skilled team members.

- Analyse the underlying metrics of the business to enable data-driven decisions.

What we expect from you 

Our undergraduates join us from many backgrounds—there is no single “right” major or course of study. 

We believe in hiring talent and training for skills. We look for driven people with potential—we will teach you the rest.

Furthermore, we expect that you:

- Are fluent in English, written and spoken. 

- Have a UK working visa, or will obtain one by the start date

- At university you were either:

- The one who fought to get the best grades possible

- The one who was tirelessly involved in extracurriculars/societies 

What comes after the internship 

For exceptional performers, you will be considered for one of the few permanent positions as an associate in the firm. Staying in the firm beyond the internship is a springboard for achieving your career goal.

Some examples of people who have completed the internship, and been >1 year in the associate role

- Been promoted to CEO in one of our group companies

- Landed offers at McKinsey, Blackrock, and Andreessen Horowitz-backed startup

- Founded a company with six-figure revenue within the first year

Starting day 

We believe in empowering you to shape your internship experience to fit your academic schedule and personal aspirations. That's the reason why you can choose from our array of internship sessions to embark on a journey that aligns perfectly with your goals:

- Spring Internship

- Summer Internship

- Fall Internship

- Winter Internship

description:

Retail Insights is Northern Europe’s leading retail forum. We are strengthening the retail ecosystem by building a platform for insights, inspiration, and networking, connecting more than 3,000 leaders yearly from more than 15 countries.

Retail Insights is part of United Media which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.

What we offer you

This is an opportunity to build exceptional sales skills while helping us grow some of the world's leading business conferences.

You’ll join our London team and receive the training, coaching and responsibility to accelerate your development from day one.

- 
Training & Coaching: Ongoing feedback and support from our leadership team.

- 
Uncapped earning potential . Competitive base salary plus an attractive commission structure where your results directly impact your earnings.

- 
International exposure: Speak with senior executives, investors and business leaders from around the world and attend our international conferences.

- 
Fast career progression: We promote internally and give high performers significant responsibility early in their careers.

- 
25 days' holiday 

- 
Great team culture: Regular team socials, lunches and events.

Your responsibilities

Your mission will be to drive revenue by selling delegate passes to senior professionals attending our international conferences.

You will:

- 
Drive new business: Proactively reach out to prospective delegates and convert them into paying attendees.

- 
Own your targets: Take responsibility for ambitious monthly revenue goals and work towards exceeding them.

- 
Execute high-volume outreach: Generating qualified sales opportunities and proposals.

- 
Manage your pipeline: Own prospects from first conversation through follow-up, proposal and close.

- 
Become an expert: Build a strong understanding of our conferences, audiences and industries so you can sell with confidence.

What we expect from you

Most importantly, you want to sell. You enjoy speaking with people, working towards ambitious targets and the feeling of turning an opportunity into a closed deal.

We’re looking for someone who has:

- 
At least 1 year of B2B sales experience , ideally involving outbound prospecting, new business or a high-volume sales environment.

- 
Drive & ambition: You are highly motivated, competitive and want to perform at a high level.

- 
Commercial mindset: You are energised by targets, revenue and the opportunity to directly influence your earnings.

- 
Resilience: You are comfortable with outbound activity and have the persistence to keep going when you hear "no".

- 
Strong communication skills: You are confident speaking with new people and can build rapport quickly.

- 
Ownership: You take responsibility for your targets, pipeline and follow-ups.

- 
Growth mindset: You actively seek feedback and continuously look for ways to improve.

We welcome applications from recent graduates and early-career professionals, provided you have at least one year of B2B sales experience and can demonstrate the drive, communication skills and competitive mindset needed to succeed in a high-performance sales environment.

Start date: As soon as possible.

Monday–Friday, we work from our WeWork office in Victoria, London . Due to the collaborative nature of our work, we do not offer remote work.

You must have the right to work in the UK.

title: Ad Solutions & Campaign Management Intern
description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

Job Description 

The New York Times' Advertising team is looking for an Ads Solutions and Campaign Management Intern to join the team. As an Ads Solutions and Campaign Management intern, you will support the post-sale creative production, trafficking, delivery and reporting of digital campaigns across The New York Times portfolio. You will work closely with Campaign Managers and Producers to ensure that advertiser creatives align with client expectations and that campaigns are set up accurately, deliver on schedule and meet our quality standards.

About The Role 

This internship is an opportunity to gain hands-on experience and training in digital creative production and ad operations within a global, premium publisher environment. This is a hybrid role based in our Paris headquarters, reporting to the Director, Ad Solutions & Operations. You can typically expect to be in the office 3 days per week. The position will start from September for a duration of 6 months, based in Paris. Candidates must have the right to work in France for the full duration of the internship.

- This internship is intended for students or recent graduates who meet the legal requirements for an internship (stage) in France with a mandatory “Convention de stage”.

- To apply, please submit:

- Your CV

- A short cover letter explaining your interest in digital advertising and this specific role

Responsibilities: 

- Support Ad Solutions in the creative production process:

- Helping compile specs and example executions for clients based on signed media plans

- Reviewing assets for technical specification compliancy

- Customising units according to client guidelines using CSS3

- Testing ads across browsers, screen sizes and devices

- Support Campaign Managers with the end-to-end setup of digital campaigns, including:

- Collecting and validating creative assets and tracking tags

- Trafficking campaigns in GAM, AdSwizz and LiveIntent 

- Assist in monitoring live campaigns:

- Reviewing pacing and delivery reports

- Flagging under-delivery or issues to the Campaign Manager in a timely manner

- Supporting optimisations based on performance and client objectives

- Contribute to campaign reporting:

- Pulling performance data from ad servers and other platforms

- Assisting in the preparation of client-facing reports and post-campaign summaries

- Support day-to-day operations:

- Collaborating with Sales, Planning and other internal stakeholders on campaign-related tasks

- Maintaining internal dashboards and trackers as required

- Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.

Basic Qualifications: 

- Interest in digital advertising

- Experience working with numbers and spreadsheets (e.g. basic formulas, filtering and pivot tables in Excel/Google Sheets) 

- Experience with a detailed and structured working style

- Experience prioritizing competing programs, responsibilities, and projects

- Professional proficiency in English

Preferred Qualifications: 

- Basic understanding of digital advertising concepts (impressions, clicks, CTR, viewability, targeting, etc.)

- Familiarity with HTML5, CSS3 and JS. 

- Exposure to or interest in ad serving, analytics or marketing platforms (e.g. Google Ad Manager, campaign management tools, web analytics)

- Experience working with datasets, reporting or dashboards (e.g. coursework, projects, part-time roles)

- Previous internship or work experience in media, advertising, marketing or a related field

- Professional proficiency in French

title: Account Manager - Asset Impact
description:
Asset Impact is seeking an Account Manager whose primary responsibilities will be to own and develop existing accounts end-to-end. This spans client onboarding, relationship management, product delivery and business development. Reporting to senior management, the Account Manager will be directly responsible for our existing clients.

The position requires a candidate skilled in building and maintaining relationships across multiple stakeholders within large institutional clients. The ideal candidate will have demonstrated experience in strategic account planning and execution and a customer-first mindset. They will have significant client-facing experience, be organized and highly detail-oriented, and enjoy structuring and improving internal processes. 

We are also looking for a strong track record in account management and/or sales, particularly with, or within, financial institutions. Knowledge of sustainability and the energy transition is desirable but not essential. 

In this role, you will play a vital part in the Asset Impact team. You will also have the opportunity to collaborate with business development teams across the wider GRESB group to identify and realize cross-selling opportunities. 

We offer a unique opportunity to play a global role in a mission-driven organization that is paving the way to a more sustainable economy. 

Your responsibilities 

We work with large global financial institutions, governments, consultancies, and non-profit organizations to catalyze action on climate change through data and analytics on the energy transition. In your role, you will own relationships with existing clients and partners, which include many of the world’s largest banks. 

Your responsibilities will include:

- Own account management framework and execution across the business.
- Own long-term relationships across our book of existing institutional clients. Proactively understand and develop their priorities, use cases and challenges, and identify and develop key internal sponsors. 
- Meet net revenue retention targets by identifying and closing new business opportunities with existing clients.
- Continuously monitor and improve account management strategy and execution, including through refinement of existing processes and tooling.
- Convey feedback to the Product team to support the improvement of existing products and provide input to the product roadmap.
- Manage delivery of products to clients, in coordination with the Product team.
Requirements 

- Five or more years of experience working in a client-facing role, for example in a consultant, sales or client relationship position. Previous experience in the areas of climate, sustainability and/or the financial industry is strongly preferred.
- Experience in building and managing relationships with institutional clients, particularly in the banking sector.
- Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., business, engineering, economics, sustainable finance). Master’s degree is preferred.
- Comfortable using AI tools to manage, improve and track account management processes and workflows. 
- Exemplary verbal and written communication skills. Fluency in English is mandatory. 
- Other European languages will be considered a strong plus, particularly French.
- Based in London, Paris, or Amsterdam.
Benefits 

- Competitive salary commensurate with experience.
- Annual professional development budget of €2,500 or equivalent, along with transport, meal allowance and additional benefits that vary by location.
- A dynamic international team of sustainable finance specialists, data scientists and business experts passionate about the climate transition.
- An impact-driven organization with wide-ranging opportunities to obtain hands-on experience, make your voice heard, and help shape the future of climate data in the financial industry.
- Scope for your role and responsibilities to evolve over time along with the growth of GRESB/Asset Impact and in line with your skills and interests. Growth potential in team management, product expertise, and pre-sales capabilities.
- The opportunity to develop your network by being involved with all types of sustainable finance stakeholders (banks, investment managers, technology and data companies, and industry bodies).
- Offices in London, Paris, Berlin, and Amsterdam with opportunities for business-related travel.

If you meet our criteria and are passionate about driving sustainability and transparency in the financial industry, we would love to hear from you. Please submit a CV and cover letter in English detailing your relevant experience and motivation.

Asset Impact is proud to be an equal opportunity workspace. We value diversity at our company and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital stavtus, veteran status, or disability status.

About Asset Impact 

Asset Impact is a pioneering climate data and analytics firm on a mission to transform the financial system into a powerful force for net-zero. We empower financial institutions with the most comprehensive asset-based data solutions available. 

Our unique approach maps physical assets across key sectors to companies and their investments, providing unparalleled transparency into climate risks and opportunities. Leading banks, asset managers, and regulators around the world rely on Asset Impact to measure their financed emissions, make informed investment decisions, and develop impactful net-zero transition strategies.

Asset Impact, formerly Asset Resolution, was established in 2018 in Paris by the 2 Degrees Investing Initiative , an innovative international think tank working to align financial markets with climate goals. In 2022, we became part of GRESB , the leading ESG benchmark for real estate and infrastructure investments, and became Asset Impact. We work globally and are expanding rapidly to support the growing needs of financial institutions as they embark on their journey to decarbonization.

Find out more at https://asset-impact.gresb.com/ 

ABOUT GRESB 

GRESB is a mission-driven organisation and strategic partner for sustainable and high-performing investments across real assets and climate-critical industries. We help investment professionals mitigate risk and build portfolios that are resilient, efficient, and financially attractive for long-term success.

Our Vision: An investment industry that plays a central role in creating a sustainable world.

Our Mission: To provide financial markets with actionable sustainability insights, data, and benchmarks. More than 150 global institutional and financial investors with USD 53 trillion in assets under management rely on GRESB to help guide their investment decisions, mitigating risk, improving portfolio quality, and driving long-term financial success.

The GRESB team is an energetic group of more than 100 individuals from diverse backgrounds with experience spanning sustainability, data science, software development, real estate, infrastructure, and the capital markets. Most of us work out of our head office in Amsterdam or one of our satellite offices in London, Paris, Berlin, Boston, Singapore, or Sydney. We are passionate about tackling the sustainability challenge by providing the insights that will power the markets of the future and enable investors to allocate the world's capital in a more responsible way.

GRESB is a portfolio company of BeyondNetZero, General Atlantic's climate investing platform.

title: VP of Product & Engineering - Back of House
description:
Help make the world more hospitable 

The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.

You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.

If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.

About the role 

Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:

This role owns Product and Engineering for Back of House, one of the most complex, multi-service domains on the Mews platform. Back of House covers the operational core that hotel teams rely on every day, and it needs someone who can set the product direction and run the engineering behind it, together. That combined mandate, product and engineering under one person at VP level, is rare, and the scale of hospitality technology right now makes it worth doing well.

You'll own the full domain: strategy, roadmap, and the engineering org that builds it, working closely and collaboratively with globally distributed teams across multiple time zones, and reporting into senior leadership. This isn't a narrow platform mandate. It spans product and engineering together, with the scope to make real calls on both, and the trust to run it as one connected domain.

Back of House software has to stay reliable at all times and keep improving, without ever pausing customer delivery to get there. The next phase of this role is about applying AI directly to the systems that support hotel teams, not just internal tooling, at a scale most engineering leaders never get to work at.

What You Would Do 

- Own product and engineering strategy for Back of House end to end, across a genuinely multi-service architecture.

- Run globally distributed engineering teams across multiple time zones, building the structures that let them ship together.

- Build out a management team and develop senior ICs, growing a culture that holds up at scale.

- Improve reliability, performance and technical debt as ongoing disciplines, without stopping delivery to do it.

- Decide where AI genuinely belongs in the Back of House product, and ship AI-driven improvements that change how hotel teams work day to day.

AI Fluency Level 4: in this role that means going beyond using AI to move faster yourself. You'll decide where AI belongs in the Back of House product, understand the underlying models and infrastructure well enough to make real engineering calls about them, and have already shipped something where AI was a core part of the product, not a feature added on afterwards.

For more information on AI fluency at Mews, please refer to AI Fluency at Mews: A Comprehensive Guide for Candidates on Confluence. 

What You Would Bring 

- Combined Product and Engineering ownership at VP level, with clear, end-to-end ownership of a complex, multi-service product domain.

- A track record running globally distributed engineering teams across multiple time zones.

- Experience operating inside a scaling SaaS business, ideally Series C through pre-IPO or recently public, as an operator rather than an adviser.

- Effective people leadership: managing managers, developing senior ICs, and building healthy team cultures at scale, plus a track record of improving reliability, performance and technical debt without stopping delivery.

- AI Fluency Level 4 or the equivalent hands-on experience: you've shipped AI as a genuine part of a product, not just used it to speed up your own workflow.

Nice To Have 

- Hands-on experience in hospitality technology: PMS, POS, channel management, revenue management, or closely adjacent systems.

- Travel tech experience (airlines, GDS, travel management companies), or comparable operationally critical, high-availability B2B platforms.

- Founder or early-stage builder experience, having built products from zero to scale.

If the location you're applying from wasn't originally advertised for this role, salary range information is available upon request at any point during the application/interview process - your recruiter will be able to help.

What’s in it for you? 

Our success is powered by our incredible people, supported by benefits that help them thrive.

Global benefits 

No matter where you’re based, you’ll enjoy:

- Unlimited paid holiday (yes, really)

- Participation in our company share program

- Paid parental leave (6 months fully paid for primary caregivers, 2 months for secondary, available after one year of service)

- A work from anywhere policy with flexibility to work abroad for a few weeks each year

- Relocation options, available after one year

- Flexible, hybrid working options

- A home office setup budget to make your workspace your own and a monthly work-from-home allowance

- Claude tokens, so you can automate workflows and build smarter, more efficient ways of working

Local benefits 

You'll receive additional benefits that vary by location, from healthcare and retirement plans to team events, socials and other perks. Ask us about it during your interview process.

Life at Mews 

We’re an equal opportunities employer. We value teams that reflect the diversity of the customers and communities we serve. Different perspectives make better ideas, stronger products and a more welcoming company.

We also believe transparency is important when deciding if you're the right fit. Mews is an ambitious, high-pressure environment of continuous learning and high standards. Success here requires resilience, adaptability and a willingness to solve difficult problems.

A few things that define how we work:

- High autonomy means high responsibility. People are expected to take ownership and drive outcomes. There isn’t a detailed playbook for everything, and that’s part of what makes the work challenging – and rewarding.

- Change is constant. We’re growing quickly and adapting as we scale. Teams, processes and priorities continue to evolve, and only people who stay curious and agile will thrive.

- We’re remote-first, not relationship-free. Flexibility is core to how we work, but strong relationships still matter. Our teams are global, so we need expert collaborators and communicators to help us move forward together.

- AI is an integral part of our processes. It’s not here to steal people’s jobs, but to amplify efficiency and productivity. We’re motivated to proactively use the technology to seek out better ways of working and share our findings with the rest of the company.

If there's anything we can do to support you during the application process, let us know.

We don't discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability or any other protected characteristic.

One final thing: don't hold back. If you don't meet 100% of the criteria in this job description but you're certain you could make a big impact, apply. Everyone should have equal access to opportunities, and we're committed to providing an inclusive experience.

If Mews sounds like the kind of environment where you'd thrive, we'd love to hear from you.
