title: Product Manager – Android Integration & Ecosystem
description:
Your mission As our Product Manager – Android Integration & Ecosystem , you will define the product what and why for how ProGlove devices connect, integrate and create value within the enterprise Android ecosystem.

ProGlove is evolving from a wearable scanner company into a Worker Companion company, bringing together ergonomic wearable hardware, software, connectivity, workflow guidance, data and intelligence. With the MAI Wearable Companion, we are entering a broader ecosystem of enterprise applications, technologies, standards, partners and customer infrastructure.

Your mission will be to make our products easy to adopt, integrate and deploy at scale – without turning every customer opportunity into a bespoke engineering project. You will identify recurring customer needs, translate them into scalable capabilities and propositions, and decide where ProGlove should own, enable or partner. In doing so, you will help turn integration from a technical necessity into a source of differentiation, customer value and commercial opportunity.

You will work closely with the Product Manager responsible for the Wearable Companion device. While they own the device proposition, you will own how the device connects to and creates value in the wider ecosystem. Together, you will shape a coherent end-to-end proposition for customers, developers, integrators and partners.

Your day-to-day 
- Define and evolve the product strategy and priorities for ProGlove’s enterprise Android integration and ecosystem capabilities, aligned with customer needs and business goals.
- Work directly with customers, Sales and Solution Architecture to identify recurring problems, distinguish individual requests from broader market needs and turn the right opportunities into scalable solutions.
- Translate recurring integration needs into repeatable product capabilities such as APIs, SDKs, tools, interfaces, documentation, integration patterns and deployment solutions.
- Shape the product experience around device setup, provisioning, application distribution, device management and other capabilities required to deploy and operate connected device fleets at scale.
- Make clear, pragmatic decisions about where ProGlove should own, enable or partner , balancing customer value, strategic control, speed, scalability and technical complexity.
- Identify the platforms, applications, standards and ecosystem players that matter to our customers, and shape the integrations, certifications and technology partnerships that strengthen our proposition.
- Explore where integration capabilities, software, services and ecosystem propositions can create differentiated value and support commercial or recurring-revenue opportunities.
- Partner closely with Engineering and the Product Manager for the Wearable Companion to create alignment on customer problems, priorities, trade-offs and desired outcomes.
- Enable Sales and other customer-facing teams to clearly explain our Android proposition, supported capabilities, integrations and common deployment patterns.
- Maintain a forward-looking view of enterprise Android, AOSP, enterprise mobility, AI and adjacent technologies, and translate relevant developments into strategic options and product priorities.

Your profile At ProGlove, technical expertise matters, but how you work is just as important. We are looking for someone who takes ownership, stays curious, collaborates openly and turns complexity into clear, pragmatic decisions.

- You bring strong Product Management experience in B2B or enterprise technology and can define strategy, discover meaningful customer problems, prioritize opportunities and turn them into scalable products or propositions.
- You are commercially minded and naturally connect product decisions with customer value, differentiation, business impact and opportunities to capture value.
- You are comfortable working with enterprise software, platforms, connected devices, integrations or technology ecosystems, and understand the realities of complex customer IT environments.
- You have enough technical depth to understand architecture, interfaces and trade-offs, contribute credibly to platform and integration discussions, and recognize when deeper engineering expertise is needed.
- You think in systems and patterns: when faced with a customer requirement, you look beyond the immediate request to understand why it exists, how broadly it applies and what a simple, repeatable solution could look like.
- You take end-to-end ownership, move topics forward without waiting for perfect instructions and remain effective when the product space or path ahead is not yet fully defined.
- You collaborate generously and build trust across Product, Engineering, Sales, Solution Architecture, customers and external partners. You can create alignment and drive decisions without relying on formal authority.
- You communicate clearly and transparently, raise risks early and can make complex technical and commercial topics understandable to different audiences.
- You are curious about customers, the business and emerging technologies, and continuously test assumptions rather than pursuing technology for its own sake.
- You use pragmatic judgment to balance speed, simplicity, quality and long-term value.
- You are fluent in English and comfortable working in an international environment.
Experience in one or more of the following areas would be valuable, but is not required:

- Enterprise Android, AOSP or adjacent Android ecosystems, including environments operating outside standard Google Mobile Services.
- Enterprise mobility management, MDM/EMM, device provisioning, application deployment or connected fleet management.
- Rugged or industrial devices, IoT or edge devices, connected hardware or other B2B technology ecosystems.
- APIs, SDKs, developer or integrator experiences and enterprise integrations.
- Platform or ecosystem strategy, technology partnerships, certification programs or developer and partner ecosystems.
- Enterprise customers deploying technology at scale.
Direct Android Product Management experience is an advantage, but not essential if you bring strong Product Management expertise and relevant experience from an adjacent enterprise technology ecosystem.

Why us? This is an opportunity to shape an important part of a category that is still being defined. 
Android gives ProGlove access to a much broader technology ecosystem, but the opportunity goes far beyond compatibility. You will help determine what role ProGlove should play in that ecosystem, which capabilities we should own, where we should partner, what customers and developers should be able to build around us, and where integration itself can become a source of differentiation and recurring business value. 
ProGlove already has the customer base, market credibility, technology and industrial expertise to build on. Our products are used in some of the world's most demanding operational environments. What we are now building is the next layer. 
Over time, success will mean more than making our own products easier to integrate. It will mean creating capabilities, interfaces and ecosystem relationships that customers, application providers and partners actively choose to build around - moving ProGlove from ecosystem participant toward ecosystem shaper. 
If you are excited by the idea of turning complex technology ecosystems into simple, valuable products - and helping shape how the next generation of frontline technology connects with the digital world - we would love to meet you. 
Join us in building the future of frontline work.

What success looks like - ProGlove has a clear, customer-backed strategy and prioritized roadmap for Android integration and ecosystem capabilities.
- Recurring customer and integration needs are turned into scalable, repeatable solutions rather than one-off engineering projects.
- Customers can adopt, integrate, deploy and manage ProGlove devices more easily within their existing enterprise environments.
- Decisions about what ProGlove should own, enable or partner are made transparently and based on customer value, business impact and long-term scalability.
- Product, Engineering, Sales and Solution Architecture are aligned on priorities, supported capabilities and key trade-offs.
- Customer-facing teams can confidently communicate our Android proposition and common deployment patterns without relying on Product or Engineering in every opportunity.
- Relevant integrations, partnerships and commercial opportunities are identified, validated and translated into tangible product or business outcomes.

Meet your team You will join our Product team and report directly to the CPO. You will work especially closely with the Product Manager responsible for the Wearable Companion, as well as colleagues across Engineering, Sales, Solution Architecture and Product Marketing.

This is a highly cross-functional role. You will bring together customer needs, technical realities and commercial opportunities, while also building relationships with external technology partners, platform providers and integrators. The team values open collaboration, clear communication and shared ownership of outcomes.

title: Senior Software Engineer (m/w/d) | Fullstack für KI-Produkte
description:
Über uns Wie bleibt ein RAG-System präzise, wenn aus tausend Dokumenten hunderttausend werden? Wie orchestriert man mehrere Modellanbieter sauber hinter einer Oberfläche? Während anderswo noch Prototypen gezeigt werden, arbeiten unsere Kunden längst damit - mit ihren Daten, ihren Regeln, gehostet in Deutschland. Als Senior Engineer verantwortest du Kernfunktionen und Architektur unserer Plattform, vom Retrieval bis ins Frontend - und du entwickelst sie so, wie wir arbeiten: AI-gestützt, mit Coding-Agents als Teil des Werkzeugkastens und mit echtem Gestaltungsspielraum für deine Ideen. Du suchst eine Rolle, in der technische Tiefe und Produktverantwortung zusammenkommen? Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen!

Das gibt es zu tun - Architektur & Umsetzung Du entwirfst und skalierst verteilte Systeme und Microservices - immer mit Blick auf Wartbarkeit, Stabilität und die Frage, was in zwei Jahren noch trägt. 
- KI-Features bauen, die im Alltag halten Du entwickelst die Kernfunktionen unserer Plattform - von RAG-basierten Wissensdatenbanken über KI-Apps für einzelne Fachbereiche bis zu Voice-, Übersetzungs- und Analytics-Funktionen. 
- Full-Stack liefern Du entwickelst performante APIs, modellierst Daten und Datenbanken und setzt moderne Oberflächen im Frontend um - vom Retrieval bis zur Benutzeroberfläche.
- Daten, Sicherheit & Mandantenfähigkeit Du modellierst Daten für Multi-Tenancy und rollenbasierte Berechtigungen - so, dass niemand über die KI Zugriff auf etwas bekommt, das er nicht sehen darf. Verschlüsselung, Datenminimierung und Auditierbarkeit denkst du von Anfang an mit. 
- Betrieb & Observability mitdenken Du sorgst dafür, dass Qualität, Kosten und Verhalten der KI-Features im Betrieb sichtbar bleiben - mit Evaluations, Monitoring und klaren Guardrails, damit die Plattform auch bei wachsender Nutzung stabil und effizient läuft.
- Komplexität beherrschen Du entwickelst bestehende Systeme weiter, schaffst klare Strukturen und reduzierst technische Schulden dort, wo sie langfristig teuer werden und lässt sie stehen, wo sie es nicht sind. 
- AI-gestützt entwickeln – und den Standard dafür setzen Du arbeitest selbstverständlich mit Coding-Assistenten und Agenten, holst mehr aus ihnen heraus als Autocomplete und weißt genau, wo ihre Grenzen liegen. Neue Tools und Workflows testest du früh, bewertest sie ehrlich und etablierst im Team, wie wir sie sinnvoll einsetzen.
- Team & Produkt weiterbringen Du arbeitest eng mit Product Owner, UX und unseren Consultants zusammen, übersetzt echte Kunden-Use-Cases in Technik, machst technische Entscheidungen transparent und bringst unsere Junior Developer durch Code Reviews und Mentoring fachlich weiter. 

Das bringst Du mit - Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Entwicklung komplexer Softwaresysteme, idealerweise im KI- bzw. SaaS/Cloud-Umfeld
- Sehr gute TypeScript-Kenntnisse, Erfahrung mit Node.js und idealerweise Frameworks wie NestJS 
- Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Softwarearchitektur für verteilte Systeme - Microservices, API-Design, Skalierung 
- Erfahrung im Frontend, z. B. mit Vue.js, sowie ein gutes Verständnis für Full-Stack-Zusammenhänge 
- Fundierte Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Datenbanken (z. B. PostgreSQL), Datenmodellierung und Performance-Optimierung 
- Erfahrung mit Cloud-Plattformen (z. B. AWS), Docker und dem Betrieb von SaaS-Anwendungen 
- AI-gestütztes Entwickeln ist für dich Alltag: Du arbeitest routiniert mit Coding-Assistenten und -Agenten (z. B. Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot), kennst ihre Grenzen und prüfst generierten Code kritisch, statt ihm zu vertrauen 
- Du bist nah am Puls der Entwicklung: Du probierst neue Tools, Modelle und Workflows aktiv aus und bringst die guten ins Team - Erfahrung mit agentischen Setups (z. B. Coding-Agents in der Cloud, MCP-Integrationen, automatisierte Reviews) ist ein starkes Plus 
- Tieferes Verständnis moderner AI-/LLM-Konzepte wie RAG, Function Calling, Embeddings oder Agenten
- Clean Code, Testing und Code Reviews sind für dich selbstverständlich und du bringst Junior Developers durch Reviews und Mentoring gern fachlich weiter 
- Du triffst technische Entscheidungen und kannst sie nachvollziehbar vertreten - auf Deutsch und auf Englisch 
- Erfahrung mit DSGVO, ISO 27001 oder dem EU AI Act sind ein Plus 

Was uns wichtig ist 
Frameworks kann man lernen. Was uns viel wichtiger ist: Verantwortung übernehmen, das Produkt mitdenken, Anforderungen konstruktiv hinterfragen und technische Entscheidungen treffen, die man auch in zwei Jahren noch begründen kann - pragmatisch abgewogen zwischen Perfektion und Geschwindigkeit. Konkret heißt das: Du entwirfst morgens die Architektur für ein neues Feature, reviewst mittags Pull Requests, entwickelst nachmittags selbst und bringst dabei unser Team fachlich weiter. Wer lieber Tickets abarbeitet und auf Anforderungen wartet, wird bei uns nicht glücklich.

Das bekommst Du - Start & Welcoming so wie du es verdienst! Ein strukturiertes Onboarding mit echten Ansprechpersonen - damit du vom ersten Tag an durchstartest.
- Remote Work Homeoffice innerhalb von Deutschland oder Arbeiten in unserem modernen Büro in Offenburg? Arbeite so, wie es für dich am besten passt.
- AI-first arbeiten, statt darüber zu reden Lizenzen für Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot & Co. stellen wir. Neue Tools und Modelle darfst du ausprobieren, statt sie zu beantragen – und deine Erkenntnisse verändern, wie das ganze Team arbeitet. 
- Kurze Wege, keine Entscheidungsgremien Architekturentscheidungen trifft das Team, das sie später auch betreibt. Deine Ideen landen im Produkt, nicht in einem Backlog-Archiv. 
- Betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit 20 % Arbeitgeberzuschuss - deutlich über dem gesetzlichen Standard.
- Du entscheidest ob Hansefit -Mitgliedschaft oder 50 € monatlich per Spendit Card - dein Benefit, deine Wahl.
- Urlaub , der mit dir wächst: 30 Tage Jahresurlaub + dazu Weihnachten und Silvester frei - und mit steigender Betriebszugehörigkeit kommen weitere Tage dazu. 
- Jobticket oder JobRad - wir machen deinen Weg ins Office einfacher und grüner.
- Feiern gehört dazu - Quarterly Allhands Events, Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier oder einfach so - wir wissen, wie man Korken knallen lässt.
- Ein Team, das wirklich zählt. Flache Hierarchien, schnelle Entscheidungen und ein offenes Ohr auch für das, was dich persönlich bewegt.

Das sind WIR Transformation ist für uns kein Trend, sondern unser Auftrag: Seit 1995 begleitet die avenit Group Unternehmen dabei, sich für die digitale Zukunft neu aufzustellen - ganzheitlich, strategisch und mit klarem Blick für nachhaltige Erfolge. Mit avenit und Vusyon vereinen wir zwei starke Kräfte - langjährige führende Digitalexpertise und modernste KI-Technologie - zu einem Partner für maßgeschneiderte Lösungen, die wirklich funktionieren. Wir glauben daran, dass nachhaltiger Erfolg auf Augenhöhe entsteht; im echten Dialog mit unseren Kunden. Unsere 60 Kolleg:innen lassen diese Vision jeden Tag zur Realität werden. Werde Teil eines Teams, das Zukunft nicht nur denkt, sondern gestaltet. Unser innovatives KI-Team in der Vusyon GmbH sucht Verstärkung, um unsere KI-Plattform für den Mittelstand weiter zu entwickeln. Neugierig, was uns dort besonders macht? Du besetzt nicht einfach offene Stellen – du gewinnst die Menschen, die unser Unternehmen morgen mitgestalten.

Qualifikation

Für diese Position wünschen wir uns eine Persönlichkeit, die folgende Eigenschaften mitbringt:

title: Quality Engineering Lead (m/w/d)
description:
Shopware ist ein führendes E-Commerce-System, das Unternehmen weltweit dabei unterstützt, im digitalen Handel schnell und effizient zu wachsen. Als zukunftsweisende Open-Source-Lösung wird Shopware bereits von einigen der größten europäischen Marken, Händlern und Herstellern im B2C- und B2B-Bereich eingesetzt. 

Als Quality Engineering Lead führst und entwickelst du ein Team von Quality Engineers und trägst dazu bei, die Zuverlässigkeit der Commerce-Plattform von Shopware zu verbessern. Du verbindest Mitarbeiterführung mit praktischer Arbeit in den Bereichen Testing und Automatisierung. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Engineering- und Produktteams zusammen, um Risiken frühzeitig zu erkennen und die Entwicklung sowie Veröffentlichung unserer Software kontinuierlich zu verbessern. 

Du übersetzt Unternehmensziele und Produktprioritäten in eine Quality-Engineering-Roadmap mit klaren und messbaren Verbesserungszielen. Du setzt Prioritäten, delegierst Aufgaben und stellst dich direkt komplexen Herausforderungen im Testing. 

- Führe, unterstütze und entwickle das Team durch regelmäßiges Feedback, Mitarbeitergespräche und individuelle Karriereentwicklung. Unterstütze außerdem bei der Einstellung und beim Onboarding. 

- Definiere gemeinsam mit den Engineering-Kolleg:innen die Teststrategie und Qualitätsstandards für die Produktteams. Priorisiere und verteile Quality-Engineering-Aufgaben entsprechend den Produktrisiken, Roadmap-Zielen und Teamkapazitäten. 

- Arbeite aktiv an Testdesign, Testautomatisierung und explorativem Testing mit. Unterstütze bei der Analyse komplexer Fehler und validiere Änderungen, die mehrere Produktbereiche betreffen. 

- Unterstütze Quality Engineers, Entwickler:innen und Product Manager teamübergreifend bei der Umsetzung der Teststrategie und dabei, Qualität frühzeitig in Planung und Entwicklung zu berücksichtigen. 

- Verbessere Testwerkzeuge und -praktiken, einschließlich des verantwortungsvollen Einsatzes KI-gestützter Tests. Nutze Kundenprobleme, Fehler und die Zuverlässigkeit von Tests, um Verbesserungspotenziale zu identifizieren. 

- Unterstütze Produkt-Releases, indem du Testergebnisse, verbleibende Risiken und eine klare Qualitätsempfehlung an die für den Release koordinierenden Kolleg:innen kommunizierst. 

Das bringst du mit: 

- Erfahrung in der Führung eines technischen Teams, einschließlich Coaching, Performance-Gesprächen und individueller Weiterentwicklung. 

- Praktische Erfahrung im Softwaretesting, in der Entwicklung von Teststrategien und in der Testautomatisierung, einschließlich Ansätzen wie End-to-End-, API-, Integrations- oder Komponententests. 

- Erfahrung in der Definition und Präsentation von Qualitätsmetriken sowie darin, diese gemeinsam mit Testergebnissen und Risikobewertungen zu nutzen, um Lücken zu erkennen und Entscheidungen zu unterstützen. 

- Die Fähigkeit, Prioritäten zu setzen, Aufgaben zu delegieren und effektiv mit Kolleg:innen aus den Bereichen Engineering und Produkt zusammenzuarbeiten. 

- Sehr gute schriftliche und mündliche Englischkenntnisse sowie die Fähigkeit, technische Sachverhalte und Abwägungen verständlich zu erklären. Deutschkenntnisse sind nicht erforderlich. 

Hilfreich, aber nicht zwingend erforderlich 

Erfahrung im E-Commerce, mit Open-Source-Software, Cloud-Anwendungen, Upgrades und Migrationen sowie mit KI-gestützter Entwicklung und Testautomatisierung ist von Vorteil. Vorkenntnisse in Shopware sind nicht erforderlich. 

Wir begrüßen vielfältige Karrierewege und Perspektiven. Du musst nicht in allen genannten Bereichen Erfahrung haben, um dich zu bewerben. Erzähle uns, wie dich dein bisheriger Werdegang darauf vorbereitet hat, ein Team zu führen und die Softwarequalität zu verbessern.

title: Head of Talent Acquisition (6-month contract)
description:
About CarbonChain

The fight against Climate Change is evolving rapidly. Climate tech is changing. The first wave was reporting. The next is treating carbon the way companies treat money: as a way to decide what to buy, who to sell to, and which incentives to claim. 

Around the world, carbon is becoming a condition of trade. Border taxes, free allocations, green premiums, cheaper capital. It looks a lot like the post-war rebuild: governments put capital and tax incentives on the table, and the companies that could keep the books moved first. The missing piece then was bookkeeping. The missing piece now is the same, carbon accounting. 

CarbonChain is that bookkeeping. We turn messy, real-world supply-chain data into numbers a trader, a sustainability lead, or a CFO will actually use. 

We want people who are agents of change, who feel the impact of climate change and know there is no way around it to create a better future for every being. 

People who know the customer is the truth of how a company thrives. People who treat data as the fuel for how fast society can change. People who use AI to accelerate the cause for good by working through an AI lens first to automate repetitive tasks and analyse data. Finally, people who enjoy working with people. 

Our Product

We help the world's largest commodity producers and traders measure and cut emissions, with verified primary data where we can get it and defensible defaults where we cannot. The platform turns operational and supplier files into decision-grade carbon and compliance insight: sourcing, CBAM, product and corporate footprints, reporting customers and regulators will stand behind. 

We organise carbon accounting around the user in four contexts at once: 

- Immediate: the tools in front of them 

- Internal: how they work with colleagues 

- External: how they work with suppliers and customers 

- Societal: how they work with society, governments, and disclosing bodies 

The data we hold is only useful if it makes all four of those jobs easier. 

About the Role

Reporting to the Head of Operations and partnering closely with the founders and technical leadership, the Head of Talent Acquisition will assume full ownership of the talent acquisition function during a critical period of growth. This is a hands-on appointment, combining strategic responsibility for the hiring roadmap with direct delivery against a defined set of vacancies. 

The role carries a clearly defined mandate: the successful appointment will lead the recruitment of approximately 5-8 senior engineering and product hires over the contract term, while simultaneously professionalising the recruitment systems, processes and capability that will underpin the company's hiring beyond it. 

What You'll Do

Key responsibilities 

- Developing and delivering a talent acquisition strategy aligned to the organisation's growth ambitions and headcount plan 

- Partnering with the senior leadership team and hiring managers to define role requirements, success profiles and structured scorecards for each vacancy 

- Taking direct ownership of senior technical recruitment, including proactive sourcing, candidate engagement, assessment and offer management 

- Designing and embedding a consistent, structured interview process, including interviewer training and calibration for hiring managers across the business 

- Reducing reliance on external recruitment agencies through the development of direct sourcing capability and a sustainable talent pipeline 

- Championing an outstanding candidate experience and acting as a credible ambassador for the CarbonChain brand in a competitive technical market 

- Leading offer negotiation and closing activity, including compensation benchmarking and equity discussions appropriate to the company's stage 

- Optimising the applicant tracking system and establishing meaningful reporting on pipeline health, time to hire, source effectiveness and cost per hire 

- Delivering a documented talent acquisition playbook and comprehensive handover to enable the business to operate the function effectively at the conclusion of the contract 

Measures of success 

- Delivery of the agreed engineering and product vacancies within the contract term 

- A reduction in median time from first candidate contact to offer to under 45 days. A demonstrable reduction in agency expenditure, with the majority of hires delivered through direct and referred channels 

- Structured scorecards and interview loops in place and in active use across all open roles 

- A documented playbook, an accurate applicant tracking system and a warm pipeline in place at handover 

The Successful Applicant 

The successful candidate will be an accomplished in-house talent acquisition professional with a strong track record of senior technical hiring in a high-growth, venture-backed environment. 

You will likely bring 

- Proven ownership of engineering and product recruitment for 5y+ within seed to Series B technology businesses, including successful delivery of senior, staff and lead-level appointments 

- Demonstrable direct sourcing expertise, with the ability to personally generate and convert pipeline for hard-to-fill technical roles 

- Experience of designing and implementing structured interview processes and scorecards in organisations where these were not previously established 

- Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the credibility and confidence to challenge and shape hiring manager requirements 

- Comfort operating as a standalone function, balancing strategic responsibility with hands-on operational delivery 

- A strong working knowledge of the UK technology talent market, including compensation benchmarking, notice periods and visa sponsorship 

Desirable 

- Prior experience within climate technology, B2B SaaS, data infrastructure or financial technology 

- A background in recruiting full stack engineers and product managers 

- Previous contract or interim experience, with a proven ability to mobilise quickly and hand over effectively 

- Experience of successfully transitioning an organisation from agency-led to direct hiring 

- Track record of taking/developing job specs and role briefs quickly and generating candidate pipeline quickly. Not having 30 days to build beautiful processes and 'then' recruit.

- Familiarity in Greenhouse.com as an ATS, we’ve been using it for 6 years and have lot of existing data to leverage 

- Willingness to support the ad hoc sourcing of non-tech roles from time to time together with the Head of Operations. 

How We Work

As a hybrid co-located team, we're inspired by our values and anchored in hubs across the UK and US. This role would be located 3d/week in our London LABS Camden office space. The in-office requirement reflects the collaborative nature of the appointment: the successful candidate will work in close partnership with hiring managers, lead interview debriefs in person and host candidates on site throughout the process. 

What We Offer

- A day rate of £550 – £650, outside IR35, dependent on experience 

- An initial 6-month contract, with a potential opportunity to extend to 12 months 

- A newly created appointment with full autonomy and a clearly defined mandate 

- Direct exposure to the founders and senior leadership team of a well-funded, high-growth business 

- The opportunity to contribute to a business with a substantive and measurable climate impact 

- A collaborative London-based culture, including quarterly team offsites, regular team lunches and a well-established social calendar 

The Process

The recruitment process comprises: 

- an initial competency-based discussion covering previous hiring delivery conversation with the Head of Operations 

- a working session with a hiring manager based on a live vacancy, and 

- a final conversation with the founders 

The business intends to conclude the process within two weeks and to provide feedback within 48 hours of the final stage. 

CarbonChain values diversity and inclusion and welcomes applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds.

Hybrid in London / Remote within the UK

We’re looking for a Back End Engineer to join the Partner Flow team. 

This role is a chance to shape how thousands of small businesses find their way to iwoca. You'll join the team that owns iwoca's partner integrations — the Lending API and embedded flows that let third-party platforms, from major banks to fintechs, offer iwoca loans inside their own customer journeys. You'll own projects, collaborate with stakeholders, and design robust systems to deliver important functionality and measurably improve the experience for our partners and customers.

The company 

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don't wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that's as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We've already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team 

iwoca partners with a variety of third-party platforms, ranging from large banks and comparison sites to small fintechs that serve SME customers. These partners use iwoca’s Lending API to embed iwoca loans into their own customer journey. Partnerships are an important and fast-growing source of customers for iwoca.

The Partner Flow team builds new features and optimises existing flows to provide the best possible experience for iwoca's partners and the customers they refer to us. The team’s responsibilities include:

- Continually improving our Lending API and other developer tools, so that partners can integrate with iwoca quickly and easily.

- Adding new functionality to facilitate deeper integrations and ensure iwoca is the best embedded finance provider on the market.

- Improving the conversion rate of customers who come to us through partners - streamlining the journey, running RCTs (randomised control trials) and building models alongside our embedded data scientist to find what works.

The team is made up of three engineers, a data scientist plus a team lead, working closely with an internal team of commercial stakeholders. This role is one of two new engineering hires as we grow the team to meet our ambition.

Partner Flow is remote/hybrid-friendly, meeting up for team days in the office once or twice a month, but not on a fixed schedule. They work in an Agile fashion with two-week sprints and a daily standup.

The role 

You’ll work on challenging projects all over iwoca’s codebase - anywhere there are improvements to be made for partners and partner-referred customers. You’ll be encouraged to bring your own ideas and take responsibility for areas of functionality.

Autonomy:

- Own features and projects from scoping and design through to production.

- Collaborate with other engineers to meet the team’s goals, whilst being trusted to define your own solutions and work independently on your part of the problem.

- Design and maintain robust, flexible, and maintainable systems to ensure scalability and fast-paced development.

Impact:

- Deliver new functionality critical to onboarding important new partners.

- Run experiments (RCTs) and optimise the funnel to measurably improve how partner-referred customers convert.

- Leave code, docs, and processes in better shape than you found them.

Purpose and product thinking:

- Work on systems that genuinely help businesses get the funding they need.

- Collaborate with our partners and internal stakeholders to design effective solutions.

- Use data to make decisions, uncover insights, and refine strategies.

AI:

- We're pushing hard on AI-assisted development. Engineers here write clear technical specs, let skills and agents implement boiler-plate, and hold a high bar on code review — the person, not the model, is accountable for what merges. We expect AI output to be validated for correctness, performance and security like any other change.

- We give the team unlimited tokens across all models and expect people to experiment.

The requirements 

Essential:

- Experience designing and building scalable back-end systems, ideally in Python.

- Experience working with relational databases, ideally PostgreSQL, with an understanding of performance and maintainability considerations.

- Experience building and maintaining APIs that are easy to use, reliable, and well-documented.

- Experience managing projects end to end, from understanding business problems to designing and delivering technical solutions.

- Pragmatism in balancing delivery speed with long-term system health.

- Clear, concise written and verbal communication, focusing on outcomes and impact.

- A genuine team player: you support your teammates, share knowledge, and care about the team's success as much as your own.

- AI fluency. Experience using AI coding tools to accelerate real delivery, and a genuine interest in getting better at it - with a pragmatic sense of where it adds value and where it doesn't.

Bonus:

- Front-end development experience, particularly with React and Typescript.

- Experience with DevOps practices, including containerisation and CI/CD pipelines.

- Experience with experimentation (e.g. A/B tests or RCTs) or using data to drive product decisions.

- Working knowledge of modern data tooling - ideally Snowflake and dbt - used to build analytical or reporting pipelines.

The salary 

We expect to pay from £60,000—£85,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture 

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices 

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

- Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

- Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits 

- Flexible working hours.

- Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

- A choice between a dedicated dental plan or a health cash plan that reimburses everyday medical expenses.

- A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

- 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

- A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

- Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

- 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

- An employee equity incentive scheme.

- Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

- Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

- Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

- A learning and development budget for everyone.

- Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

title: Post-doctorant·e en sécurité et protection de la vie privée - CDD 12 mois
description:
Présentation de Télécom SudParis :

Télécom SudParis est une grande école publique d'ingénieurs reconnue au meilleur niveau des sciences et technologies du numérique. La qualité de ses formations est basée sur l’excellence scientifique de son corps professoral et une pédagogie mettant l’accent sur les projets d’équipes, l’innovation de rupture et l’entreprenariat. Télécom SudParis compte 1 000 étudiantes et étudiants dont 700 élèves ingénieurs et environ de 150 doctorantes et doctorants. Télécom SudParis fait partie de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, premier groupe d’école d’ingénieurs en France, et partage son campus avec Institut Mines-Télécom Business School. Télécom SudParis est co- fondatrice de l'Institut Polytechnique de Paris (IP Paris), Institut de Sciences et Technologies à vocation mondiale avec l’École polytechnique, l’ENSTA Paris, l’ENSAE Paris, l'ENPC et Télécom Paris. Vidéo présentation de Télécom SudParis 

À propos de l'Institut Mines-Télécom :

L'Institut Mines-Télécom (IMT) est un établissement public dédié à l'enseignement supérieur et la recherche pour l'innovation dans les domaines de l'ingénierie et du numérique. À l’écoute permanente du monde économique, l'IMT conjugue une forte légitimité académique et scientifique, une proximité avec les entreprises et un positionnement unique sur les transformations majeures au XXIe siècle : numériques, énergétiques, industrielles et éducatives siècle. Ses activités se déploient au sein des grandes écoles Mines et Télécom sous tutelle du ministre en charge de l’Industrie et des communications électroniques, de deux filiales et de partenaires associés ou sous convention. L'IMT est membre fondateur de l’Alliance Industrie du Futur. Il est doublement labellisé Carnot pour la qualité de sa recherche partenariale. Vidéo de présentation de l'Institut Mines-Télécom 

Missions

Dans le cadre du projet européen ECS (European Compliance Stack), le travail porte sur l’identité numérique, et le portefeuille d’identités numériques et vise à traiter la problématique du contrôle d’accès et de la délégation de droits d’accès. Dans le contexte des espaces de données, il faudra veiller à différentes dimensions, telles que l’interopérabilité vis-à-vis des différents espaces de données, l’expressivité des droits de manière à satisfaire la diversité des politiques de sécurité et bien entendu le niveau de sécurité.

Activités

- Concevoir une solution de portefeuille d’identités numériques innovante couvrant les aspects authentification, autorisation et délégation de droits, qui puisse facilement s’intégrer aux espaces de données existants et servir à la mutualisation des données sur plusieurs espaces. Pour cela, nous nous référerons autant que possible aux standards existants et à des services de type EuProConnect. Les portefeuilles de type business et pour les citoyens seront à l’étude, avec une attention portée pour les portefeuilles de citoyens à la préservation de la vie privée.

- Développer la solution de sorte que le prototype puisse être testé en environnement opérationnel

- Gérer les réunions et les interactions avec les partenaires

- Faire les comptes rendus de réunions et d’avancement du projet

- Valoriser les résultats sous la forme de publications dans des journaux ou conférences de renom, de vidéos, de posters, de formations…

Formation

- Doctorat ou PhD depuis moins de 3 ans

Compétences, connaissances et expériences indispensables 

- Expérience dans le domaine de la cybersécurité et de l’identité numérique

- Expérience en programmation

- Anglais parlé et écrit du fait que les interactions au sein du projet seront réalisées en anglais

Compétences, connaissances et expériences souhaitables 

- Expérience dans le domaine de la blockchain et de Hyperledger 

Capacités et aptitudes 

- Rigueur, méthode de gestion de projets

- Aisance relationnelle avec des interlocuteurs de tous niveaux, esprit d’écoute et de coopération

- Capacité à travailler en équipe

- Respect strict des obligations de confidentialité au regard des données utilisées

Indications de rémunération: 

- Fourchette indicative de rémunération (hors bonus annuel variable): 35.400- 38.000 euros bruts annuels, selon le profil et l’expérience (charges salariales réduites en secteur public).

Informations complémentaires et candidature

title: Operations Support Engineer
Tech Lead Marketplace Experience (m/w/d)
description:
Über die Position Gestalte mit uns die digitale Infrastruktur des europäischen Gartenbaus Connected Growers entwickelt June - die Plattform, über die Erzeuger, B2B Käufer und Vermarkter effizient zusammenarbeiten. Wir ersetzen fragmentierte Prozesse durch moderne Software und schaffen eine gemeinsame digitale Infrastruktur für eine ganze Branche. 

Dafür suchen wir Verstärkung als Tech Lead Marketplace Experience (m/w/d), um nicht nur Software zu entwickeln, sondern ein Team aufzubauen, technische Verantwortung zu übernehmen und gemeinsam mit dem Produkt-Team die Zukunft unserer Plattform zu gestalten. 

Deine Rolle bei June Als Tech Lead Grower Marketplace Experience (m/w/d) verantwortest du die technische Entwicklung unseres Marketplace und der dazugehörigen Services. Du berichtest direkt an unsere CTO Anna. 

Du baust einen neuen Engineering Squad von Grund auf auf und übernimmst die technische und fachliche Verantwortung für einen der kommerziell wichtigsten Bereiche von June. Es geht nicht nur darum, gute Software zu bauen: Du setzt technische Richtung, triffst Entscheidungen unter Unsicherheit, entwickelst Menschen, und prägst die Kultur deines Squads. Du sorgst gemeinsam mit dem Produkt-Team dafür, dass wir Funktionen entwickeln, die für unsere Kunden messbaren Mehrwert schaffen. 

Wir geben dir den Kontext und den Freiraum, den du brauchst, um deinen Bereich eigenständig zu führen. Im Gegenzug erwarten wir, dass du Verantwortung übernimmst, Entscheidungen triffst und auch für ihre Konsequenzen einstehst – in einem dynamischen Umfeld, in dem sich Prioritäten verändern und Informationen nicht immer vollständig vorliegen. 

Du bist kein klassischer People Manager. Du führst über technische Tiefe, Klarheit, Entscheidungen und Vertrauen. Du bleibst hands-on im Code, ohne zum technischen Bottleneck zu werden, triffst Architekturentscheidungen und unterstützt dein Team dabei, gemeinsam hochwertige Software zu entwickeln. 

Unser Marketplace basiert auf dem Spryker Commerce OS . Du entwickelst ein klares Verständnis dafür, wann wir innerhalb der Spryker-Konventionen arbeiten, wann wir erweitern und wann eine individuelle Lösung sinnvoll ist. Dabei behältst du immer die langfristige Wartbarkeit und Erweiterbarkeit unserer Plattform im Blick. 

Anforderungen Was du mitbringst - Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung als Tech Lead oder Senior Engineer in Web- und E-Commerce-Anwendungen sowie fundierte praktische Erfahrung mit PHP und Spryker Commerce OS und weißt, wann du innerhalb der Spryker-Konventionen arbeitest, erweiterst oder bewusst davon abweichst. 

- Du bringst Erfahrung mit API- bzw. Spec-first-Entwicklung sowie mit AWS-Cloud-Infrastrukturen, modernen Deployment-Prozessen und Monitoring mit. 

- Du hast bereits Erfahrung im Teamaufbau und weißt, worauf es ankommt. 

- Du hast Verständnis, Interesse und Lust an Produktentwicklung (Software) und Teamentwicklung (Menschen). 

- Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, kommunizierst klar, hast hohe Qualitätsansprüche und sprichst fließend Deutsch sowie sehr gutes Englisch. 

Das wäre ein Plus - Gute Kenntnisse in TypeScript. 

- Erfahrung mit ERP-, Warehouse- oder Commerce-Systemen. 

- Erfahrung mit komplexen Order-, Pricing- oder Inventory/Catalogue-Prozessen. 

- Erfahrung in einem Startup oder schnell wachsenden Technologieunternehmen. 

Aufgabenbereich Was du bei uns bewegst - Du verantwortest Architektur, technische Qualität und Weiterentwicklung des Marketplace und seiner Services. 

- Du baust dein Squad auf, entwickelst deine Teammitglieder weiter und schaffst eine Kultur aus Ownership, Pragmatismus und kontinuierlichem Lernen. 

- Du entwickelst eine klare technische Strategie für den Produktbereich Marketplace Experience und triffst bewusste Entscheidungen darüber, wie wir Spryker einsetzen und erweitern. 

- Du arbeitest eng mit dem Produkt-Team zusammen und übersetzt die Bedürfnisse unserer Käufer und Verkäufer in nachhaltige technische Lösungen.. 

- Du sorgst dafür, dass dein Team Software kontinuierlich, sicher und zuverlässig ausliefert – von der technischen Spezifikation und Architektur über API-Design und Entwicklung bis hin zu Betrieb, Incident Management und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung. 

- Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Performance, Stabilität, Security und Compliance und stellst sicher, dass technische Risiken früh erkannt, bewertet und bewusst adressiert werden. 

- Du nutzt AI selbstverständlich im Engineering-Alltag und hilfst deinem Team dabei, AI sinnvoll und verantwortungsvoll für Entwicklung, Testing, Dokumentation und Code Reviews einzusetzen. 

So arbeiten wir Unsere Teams verantworten ihren Produktbereich komplett: Architektur, API-Design, Entwicklung, Betrieb, Incidents, Security, Compliance. Die kommerziellen KPIs gehören dazu. 

Wir reden mit Kunden, fahren zu ihnen raus, testen unsere Lösungen dort im Betrieb. Verantwortung endet nicht am Merge-Button. 

Die Perspektive Was dich erwartet - Du baust etwas auf, statt ein bestehendes Team zu verwalten. 

- Du bekommst einen klar abgegrenzten Verantwortungsbereich und die Freiheit, ihn zu gestalten. 

- Du arbeitest direkt mit CTO und Product Manager und kannst technische, produktbezogene, kulturprägende und kommerzielle Entscheidungen tatsächlich beeinflussen. 

- Du siehst die Konsequenzen deiner Entscheidungen unmittelbar – im Produkt, im Team und im Geschäft. 

- Hybrides Arbeiten in unserem Büro in Köln sowie regelmäßige Besuche bei Kund*innen, Gärtner*innen und Partner*innen vor Ort 

Diese Stellenbeschreibung ist bewusst meinungsstark und setzt hohe Standards. Wir suchen nicht den perfekten Lebenslauf, sondern Menschen, die bei Connected Growers glücklich werden. Wenn du nicht alle formalen Kriterien erfüllst, dich aber in der Art, wie wir arbeiten und führen, wiedererkennst, freuen wir uns trotzdem über deine Bewerbung. Was dir an einzelnen Punkten noch fehlt, können wir gemeinsam entwickeln – entscheidend ist, dass du das Mindset und die Bereitschaft mitbringst, in diese Rolle hineinzuwachsen. 

Hinweis: Die Stelle wird zunächst über BridgeMaker besetzt und im weiteren Verlauf zu Connected Growers überführt.

Deine Nutzer sind Gartenbaubetriebe, deren Bedürfnisse Du durch enge Zusammenarbeit mit diesen und weiteren Experten der Branche kennenlernst. Du entwickelst daraus technische Lösungen und Standards für die Branche.

- Mindestens 4–5 Jahre Erfahrung im Produktmanagement von B2B-Softwareprodukten. 

- Erfahrung im eigenständigen Führen von User Interviews, Bereitschaft zu unregelmäßigen Vor-Ort-Besuchen bei Gärtner*innen. (Führerschein erforderlich) 

- Kenntnisse gängiger Tracking- und Analytics-Tools. 

- Exzellente schriftliche Kommunikation (Roadmaps, PRDs). 

- AI-Erfahrung am Puls der Zeit: Du bist bei neuen Entwicklungen up-to-date und findest wege, wie du AI für Deine Arbeit und eingebettet im Softwareteam effizient nutzen kannst. 

- Fließend Deutsch, sehr gutes Englisch. 

Das wäre ein Plus 

- Erfahrung mit Prozessen aus der Warenwirtschaft oder aus dem Handel. 

- Ein Software-Background kombiniert mit Product-Management-Erfahrung. 

Aufgabenbereich Was du bei uns bewegst 

- Du verantwortest die Produktstrategie und -roadmap für den Bereich Grower Experience. 

- Du sprichst wöchentlich eigenständig mit unseren Gärtner*innen, baust Beziehungen zu ihnen auf und triffst die Betriebe in unregelmäßigen Abständen auch vor Ort. 

- Du arbeitest eng mit Design und Engineering zusammen, leitest gemeinsam mit Design User Interviews und übersetzt die daraus gewonnenen Erkenntnisse in konkrete Produktentscheidungen, während Du das Team fachlich durch den gesamten Produktentwicklungsprozess führst. 

- Du verstehst und artikulierst den Business Value deiner Produktentscheidungen, u. a. über KPI-Frameworks, und nutzt Tracking- und Analytics-Daten, um Annahmen zu validieren und Produktentscheidungen datenbasiert zu treffen. 

- Du kommunizierst Roadmaps, PRDs und Produktentscheidungen klar und überzeugend – schriftlich wie mündlich. 

- Du nutzt AI selbstverständlich in deinem Alltag – für Prototyping, eigene Datenanalysen und einen effizienten, AI-gestützten Produktentwicklungsprozess gemeinsam mit deinem Engineering-Team.

title: Intern Technology & Management Consulting (Value Engineering)
description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team: 

As an Intern in Technology & Management Consulting you join our Value Engineering team to focus on driving and closing opportunities by identifying and selling the value Celonis can bring to customers. Our Value Engineers (VE) are the trusted advisor for customers and work on the intersection of technology and business. Value Engineers partner with sales and customers to create compelling solutions to critical business problems.

The Role:

Value Engineers are the trusted advisors for our prospects and customers and leverage product expertise and business acumen to solve our prospects’ and customers’ most pressing challenges You will gain experience in executing proof of value projects and take part in technical/business discussions with stakeholders. By creating customer-based business cases, you support the strategic business development activities for the French market .

The work you’ll do: 

- Analyze data from our customers to increase transparency in business processes

- Understand the pain points of our customers and translate them into actionable use cases in the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform

- Quantify financial impact of use cases implemented in the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform and prepare management ready presentations

- Present findings together with your team in front of customers’ C-level and decision makers

- Leverage Celonis data modeling and AI capabilities to uncover process inefficiencies, generate insights, and deliver high impact, data driven value propositions to clients.

- Pitch the Celonis AI value proposition and vision to customers and align our solutions with their AI strategy

- Build strong relationships with our customers by winning their trust through technical, product expertise, and business acumen

The qualifications you need: 

- Student in the field of Technology & Management, Industrial/ Business Engineering, Business Informatics, Business Administration, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics or a comparable degree program. 

- Strong communication skills and interest in interacting with potential customers

- Experience in consulting and highly interested in data analytics

- Knowledge in SQL or related database query languages

- Analytical mindset and the ability to work in a structured manner and quickly comprehend new topics

- Availability from October onwards for 6 months (full-time)

- Effective communicator and fluent in English and French 

- The internship is possible in Paris or Madrid 

What Celonis can offer you: 

- Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.

- Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.

- Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.

- Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.

- Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.

- Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.

- Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.

- Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team: 

As an Intern in AI & Management Consulting you join our Value Engineering team to focus on driving and closing opportunities by identifying and selling the value Celonis can bring to customers. Our Value Engineers (VE) are the trusted advisor for customers and work on the intersection of technology and business. Value Engineers partner with sales and customers to create compelling solutions to critical business problems.

The Role:

Value Engineers are the trusted advisors for our prospects and customers and leverage product expertise and business acumen to solve our prospects’ and customers’ most pressing challenges You will gain experience in executing proof of value projects and take part in technical/business discussions with stakeholders. By creating customer-based business cases, you support the strategic business development activities for the French market .

- Analyze data from our customers to increase transparency in business processes

- Understand the pain points of our customers and translate them into actionable use cases in the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform

- Quantify financial impact of use cases implemented in the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform and prepare management ready presentations

- Present findings together with your team in front of customers’ C-level and decision makers

- Leverage Celonis data modeling and AI capabilities to uncover process inefficiencies, generate insights, and deliver high impact, data driven value propositions to clients.

- Pitch the Celonis AI value proposition and vision to customers and align our solutions with their AI strategy

- Build strong relationships with our customers by winning their trust through technical, product expertise, and business acumen

The qualifications you need: 

- Student in the field of Technology & Management, Industrial/ Business Engineering, Business Informatics, Business Administration, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics or a comparable degree program. 

- Strong communication skills and interest in interacting with potential customers

- Experience in consulting and highly interested in data analytics

- Knowledge in SQL or related database query languages

- Analytical mindset and the ability to work in a structured manner and quickly comprehend new topics

- Availability from October onwards for 6 months (full-time)

- Effective communicator and fluent in English and French 

- The internship is possible in Paris or Madrid 

What Celonis can offer you: 

- Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.

- Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.

- Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.

- Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.

- Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. title: Sales Engineering Manager - France
description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange™️ platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 160+ public exchanges globally and thousands of private exchanges at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role 

We are looking for a Sales Engineering Manager to join our team. This is a remote role (Based in Paris, France), reporting to the Sales Engineering Director in the Solutions Consulting department. In this role, you will act as a strategic technical leader across the region, driving business performance and improving technical win rates. You will partner closely with Sales leadership to align resources with regional growth strategies while actively coaching and developing a high-performing team of Sales Engineers.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations) 

- Own the end-to-end technical sales cycle across the region, ensuring opportunities are qualified, progressed, and executed with appropriate rigor, governance, and adherence to established Sales Engineering processes, including proof-of-value planning, execution, and success measurement through the Team and the Channel Partners.

- Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing Sales Engineering team through active deal engagement, structured development plans, ongoing performance management, and continuous feedback, ensuring consistently high technical, commercial, and customer-facing standards

- Drive business performance by leading initiatives that improve technical win rates, accelerate sales cycles, increase platform adoption, and contribute directly to revenue growth across new and existing customer opportunities

- Build and maintain strong relationships with customer executives, technical leaders, and key stakeholders within assigned territories, while partnering closely with Sales leadership to anticipate territory needs, align resources to business priorities, and ensure effective execution of regional growth strategies

- Maintain a high level of technical expertise across current and emerging platform capabilities through continuous learning and achievement of relevant certifications, while attracting, developing, and retaining top talent to ensure the organization has the skills, capacity, and succession pipeline required for future success

Who You Are (Success Profile) 

- You act like an owner with a strong passion for the mission and a bias for action, navigating seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.

- You are a high-trust collaborator who is ambitious for the team, embracing a culture of candor, respect, and continuous feedback to build deep trust.

- You are customer-obsessed, building deep empathy for both internal and external stakeholders and anchoring every decision in solving real-world problems.

- You are resilient and adaptable, viewing change as an opportunity and maintaining composure to guide your team through high-pressure situations.

- You lead with integrity, holding yourself and others to high standards of accountability while building trust through transparent, consistent action.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications) 

- 8+ years enterprise pre-sales / solutions engineering experience (security, networking, cloud, or SaaS) across complex, multi-stakeholder deals with 2+ years leading, coaching and developing Sales Engineers (hiring, coaching, performance, career growth)

- Fluency in both French and English (proficiency in other European languages would be advantageous)

- Proven ability to run the regional pre-sales motion: pipeline support, deal strategy, and forecasting partnership with Sales

- Strong executive customer leadership and a deep security/networking foundation (e.g., Zero Trust, identity, secure connectivity, cloud security) with strong cross-functional collaboration and willingness to travel

- Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications) 

- Experience enabling pre-sales teams to position AI-powered threat detection, automated policy generation, or AI-driven security analytics to maximize customer value

- Proven experience leading enterprise security/cloud pre-sales teams in a high-growth SaaS environment (multi-country/multi-market a plus)

- Ability to scale and develop an SE organization (hiring, onboarding, enablement, repeatable plays, career frameworks)

title: Stage - Assistant chef de projet pour déploiement (x/f/m) - janvier 2027
description:
Vous rejoindrez l'équipe Doctolib Prévention , une équipe d'entrepreneur(euse)s qui construit une nouvelle activité depuis 2022 avec l'ambition de transformer le système de santé vers plus de prévention. 

Il existe trois formes de prévention : primaire (de l’exercice physique à la nutrition, la lutte contre les addictions ou encore la vaccination), secondaire (limiter l’impact de la maladie sur la santé à travers le dépistage du cancer du sein, de l’utérus…), et tertiaire (l’ensemble des moyens mis en œuvre pour éviter la survenue de complications et de rechutes pour les personnes atteintes de maladies chroniques). La France est bonne élève sur la prévention tertiaire, très curative, mais en retard sur la prévention primaire et secondaire, par rapport à d’autres pays européens.

- Pour les patients : notre objectif est de leur donner les moyens de devenir acteurs de leur santé avec une approche préventive, en commençant par leur offrir une information de qualité et la capacité d’agir simplement lors des campagnes de prévention nationales

- Pour les professionnels de santé : notre objectif est de leur fournir les outils adéquats pour réussir le virage vers une médecine plus préventive, en commençant par fournir une information de qualité sur l’accompagnement des patients lors des campagnes de prévention nationales

- Nous avons relayé plus d’une centaine de campagnes depuis notre lancement, en prévention primaire et secondaire (facteurs de risque, vaccination, dépistages, santé mentale…) avec des acteurs institutionnels (Santé Publique France, CNAM, Ministères…), associatifs et privés (eg : L’Oréal, MSD etc). Les campagnes sont relayées auprès de millions de Français avec un bel impact en termes de passage à l’action.

Vos missions 

Vos responsabilités incluent, mais ne sont pas limitées à :

- Contrats : Rédaction des contrats en utilisant les modèles fournis par l'équipe Legal, Suivi des contrats, y compris la mise à disposition des contrats et la gestion des signatures

- Facturation : Suivi de la facturation, y compris la création de factures ainsi que le suivi des règlements

- Marketing : Coordination avec les équipes marketing, medical excellence et site web pour la création des contenus

- Data et suivi de performance : Suivi quotidien de la performance des campagnes en cours et amélioration continue en lien avec le marketing, préparation des présentations clients, notamment les réunions de brief et le partage des résultats de campagnes et analyses ad hoc : benchmark de performance par cible, analyse des AB test pour optimiser la performance de nos campagnes

title: Senior Product Manager - Product Led Growth- Paris (x/f/m)
description:
Set a new pulse for healthcare! 

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join the Product team at Doctolib.

Your mission: scale Doctolib's acquisition engine into a measurable, lower-cost growth driver across France, Germany and Italy. You will own the end-to-end product-led and marketing-led growth funnel, from freemium offer design to subscription and in-product upsell, contributing directly to growing ARR while bringing the cost to acquire new practitioners down.

Building at Doctolib means shipping products that change how care teams and patients experience healthcare every day.

What you'll do 

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

- Own Doctolib freemium offer: define what is free, metered, or demo-only, and design the conversion paths that move practitioners to a paid plan

- Own and improve the subscription funnel for new business and upsell, across web and in-product surfaces, including checkout and sign-up unification

- Design and improve every in-product flow that moves an existing customer to a higher-value plan

- Define acquisition-side packaging: offer catalogue, eligibility rules, and contract signature flows across France, Germany and Italy

- Lead marketing-led growth initiatives, including lead generation, B2B website conversion, and lifecycle marketing, connecting them to the core product funnel

- Set the direction for cross-team delivery (along with the PMMs and other counterparts), deciding offer by offer and country by country when conversion is the right path, and when to route a user to sales as a warm, product-qualified lead

Who you are 

Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

You'll be a great fit if you: 

- You have owned a PLG conversion, ARR or CAC metric as your primary objective in B2B SaaS at scale, and can quantify what it moved, from what baseline, over what period

- You have scaled product-led growth alongside a sales motion, and can explain how you chose between autonomous conversion and handing sales a warm lead, offer by offer

- You read data yourself, define funnel measurement from scratch, and make decisions with experiments rather than opinion

- You have solid product judgement on pricing, packaging, eligibility and freemium boundaries, and can work within a regulated environment with consent and country-specific constraints in mind

- You set direction for teams you do not manage and move a metric across a cross-functional chain

- You are fluent in English

It would be fantastic if you: 

- Have owned both product-led and marketing-led growth, connecting lifecycle, attribution or lead scoring to the product funnel

- Have worked across multiple countries with different pricing or packaging constraints

- Have experience in a regulated or healthcare context

What we offer 

- Free comprehensive health insurance (basic package) for you and your children

- 25 days of paid vacation per year, plus up to 14 days of RTT

- Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care

- Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy

- Lunch vouchers (Swile card) worth €8.50 per working day, with €4.50 covered by Doctolib

- A subsidy from the work council to refund part of the membership to a sport club or a creative class

- 50% reimbursement of your public transport subscription

- ParentCare Program: full salary coverage (100%) during your first month of birth leave and 75% during the second, covered by Doctolib

- Enrollment in Doctolib's long-term employee value sharing plan called DoctoGrowth

- For caregivers and workers with disabilities, a package including an adaptation of the remote policy, extra days off for medical reasons, and psychological support

- Access to the best AI tools for coding, development and dedicated training

Our interview process 

- Talent Acquisition Interview (Maxime)

- Hiring Manager Interview (Louis Durteste)

We want your experience to be clear, respectful, and transparent. Learn more about our hiring process on our candidate experience page .

title: Sales Planning & Strategy
description:
Health can’t wait . 

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

🧩 Context of the role

You will be part of the Business Strategy & Operations (BSO) team, whose goal is to

- Define an ambitious strategy to achieve our business objectives and translate this into an actionable plan 

- Monitor and explain our performance towards our business objectives

- Enable our Sales and Account Management teams to achieve these business objectives and become the most effective commercial teams in the tech industry (i.e., Sales and AM effectiveness, tools, analytics and training)

Across all these areas we work very closely with the Senior Leadership, the Sales, Account Management and Go-to-Market teams. The scope is Global (France, Belgium, Spain and Canada for the time being).

🎯 Your mission

You will be owning medium to large scale/complexity projects (depending on your skills and experience) on the Business Planning and Strategy area. These would include: 

- Business Strategy 

- Work closely with senior business leaders (Business leads, Insurance Lead, Marketing lead, CFO, CEO, etc.) to define Alan’s business plan 

- Frame business and resource allocation decisions (e.g. where to accelerate/slow down in terms of segments or products, where to deploy sales and marketing resources, how to optimize for short vs. long term, what are is the impact on metrics such as payback, LTV, CAC)

- Propose adjustments to the plan on a quarterly basis and support Board preparation

- Sales & Account Manager Planning 

- Translate the plan into actionable sales & Account Management objectives , ensuring their quality, scalability and accuracy

- Build & improve the infrastructure to track these targets (dashboard, models) hand in hand with the data team

- Performance monitoring & Steering 

- Lead or support strategic explorations (e.g. new segment, new distribution models) to frame strategic decisions

- Monitor closely results and execution to gather learnings and adjust where necessary, sharing key learnings with the community and the company on a monthly basis

- Work on transversal topics that allow us to gain insights & better steer the team performance (competition analysis, implementation & monitoring of pricing strategies, ...)

🧐 Skills we are looking for

We look above all for exceptional people motivated and committed in building one of the most effective Strategy and Planning team.

At least 3 years of experience within either: 

- Business strategy, sales strategy & operations, revenue operations or business finance/ strategic finance departments in a B2B company (preferably)

- Management consulting, investment banking or private equity

Critical thinking and problem solving skills: 

- Ability to deal effectively with ambiguity, bringing structure to ambiguous areas of opportunity

- Deep analytical rigour, bringing clarity on complex topics through deep insights

- Great Excel skills and moderate SQL knowledge. Experience with AI tools and building moderate to complex flows.

- Ability to handle workload & short turnaround time, with a high degree of adaptability and flexibility, when some topics are top priority for the company

Business sense: 

- At ease with B2B operational and financial metrics

- Passion for getting close to the business and Sales/Marketing teams and understanding the operational details of their work, not just the strategic ones

Communication and presence: 

- Ability to communicate effectively with senior leadership and align multiple stakeholders in a collaborative way

- Ability to build successful relationships with a broad range of stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Product and Finance and be seen as a trusted contributor/advisor

- Ability to work well under pressure, with a high degree of adaptability and flexibility

- Great written and oral structure and communication

- Fluency in English (French is a strong plus)

- Being based in (or willing to relocate to) the Paris area or Barcelona 

Nice to have 

- Experience with BI and visualization tools (Metabase, Tableau) and Salesforce

- Experience in the SaaS/Tech sectors

- Exposure to large sales teams (100+)

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C1-D level range .

Au sein du département Compliance & Risk, la fonction Regulatory est un pilier stratégique : elle garantit la conformité de Lemonway vis-à-vis de ses obligations d'établissement de paiement agréé, assure la relation avec les régulateurs, et accompagne l'évolution du business dans un environnement réglementaire en mutation constante. 

Le département Compliance & Risk est composé de 4 équipes : Regulatory, AML, Legal et Internal Control & Operational Risk. Dans cette organisation, le Head of Regulatory reporte directement au Chief Compliance & Risk Officer. 

Vos missions

Relation avec les autorités de tutelle 

- Être l'interlocuteur principal de Lemonway auprès de l'ACPR et des superviseurs européens des pays dans lesquels Lemonway fournit ses services ( passporting ) 

- Préparer et coordonner certains reportings réglementaires périodiques français et européens

Conformité réglementaire produit & business

- Intégrer la dimension réglementaire dès la phase de conception des nouveaux produits et services 

- Garantir la conformité de l’entreprise au RGPD 

- Rédiger, maintenir et actualiser les politiques et procédures réglementaires internes

Veille et analyse réglementaire 

- Assurer une veille proactive sur l'évolution des textes réglementaires applicables à Lemonway en tant que PSP ainsi qu’à ses plateformes clientes, en France et en Europe (DSP3, AMLR, ECSPR, GDPR, IA Act, DORA, virements instantanés, etc.) 

- Analyser les impacts opérationnels et business des nouvelles réglementations et formuler des recommandations claires aux équipes concernées (Produit, Tech, Commercial, Finance)

Management & développement de l'équipe

Formation

Expérience

Compétences
