title: Head of Internal Control, Operational Risk - CDI (F/H)
description:
Lemonway est un établissement de paiement européen agréé, qui accompagne les marketplaces et les plateformes de crowdfunding dans plus de 29 pays. 

Nous fournissons des services de paiement sécurisés, conformes et évolutifs pour la nouvelle économie, notamment des services de KYC, de traitement des paiements, de détection de la fraude, de ségrégation des fonds et de gestion des comptes. Notre expertise technologique et réglementaire permet à nos clients de développer leur activité tout en respectant les standards les plus exigeants en matière de conformité et de sécurité.

Avec plus de 150 collaborateurs, Lemonway est une entreprise dynamique et internationale, au cœur de l’économie numérique. Nous combinons l’agilité d’une scale-up avec les exigences et les responsabilités d’un établissement financier réglementé.

Le poste 

Rattaché(e) a notre Chief Compliance & Risk Officer, vous prenez en charge les activités de contrôle interne, de gestion des risques opérationnels et de gouvernance de Lemonway. 

Vous veillez à ce que le profil de risque de l’entreprise soit correctement identifié, évalué, suivi et communiqué, tout en contribuant au renforcement de son environnement de contrôle et de sa culture du risque.

Vous managez une équipe de deux personnes et travaillez en étroite collaboration avec le CEO, la Direction générale, les fonctions de contrôle et les équipes opérationnelles. En tant que véritable business partner, vous accompagnez l’entreprise dans ses prises de décision, tout en vous assurant que ses activités restent conformes aux exigences réglementaires applicables, aux politiques internes et à l’appétit au risque défini.

Il s’agit d’un poste stratégique et opérationnel, particulièrement adapté à une personne qui apprécie de construire et d’améliorer des dispositifs dans un environnement international, en forte évolution et réglementé.

Les principales responsabilités : 

Contrôle interne et contrôle permanent 

- Piloter et améliorer en continu le dispositif de contrôle interne de niveaux 1 et 2. 

- Définir, maintenir et mettre en œuvre le plan annuel de contrôle permanent. 

- Veiller à ce que les contrôles soient correctement conçus, documentés, réalisés et justifiés. 

- Développer les indicateurs de contrôle pertinents et les reportings destinés à la Direction et aux instances de gouvernance. 

- Identifier les faiblesses du dispositif de contrôle, évaluer leur impact et coordonner les actions correctives. 

- Promouvoir une culture forte du contrôle et de la gestion des risques dans l’ensemble de l’organisation. 

- Contribuer à la mise en place et à l’optimisation des outils et processus de type GRC.

Risques opérationnels et gestion des risques 

- Piloter le dispositif de gestion des risques opérationnels, notamment l’identification, l’évaluation et le suivi des risques. 

- Coordonner la préparation et la mise à jour régulière des cartographies des risques de l’entreprise. 

- Organiser et maintenir le Risk Appetite Framework, ainsi que le suivi des indicateurs d’appétit au risque. 

- Piloter le processus de gestion et de reporting des incidents, en veillant à ce que les incidents soient enregistrés, analysés et suivis de manière appropriée. 

- Suivre les risques opérationnels, non financiers et émergents, notamment les risques liés à la technologie, à la cybersécurité, à la fraude, à l’externalisation et aux processus métiers. 

- Préparer des reportings risques clairs et exploitables à destination de la Direction générale et des instances de gouvernance concernées.

Gouvernance et comités 

- Préparer, coordonner et animer le Comité des risques trimestriel. 

- Accompagner le Chief Compliance & Risk Officer et la Direction générale dans leurs prises de décision liées aux risques. 

- Préparer les supports de gouvernance, tableaux de bord et présentations offrant une vision claire de l’environnement de risques et de contrôle de l’entreprise. 

- Coordonner la définition et la mise à jour des rôles et responsabilités, notamment au travers des matrices RACI. 

- Contribuer aux processus de reporting réglementaire et interne, notamment au rapport annuel sur le contrôle interne, ainsi qu’aux autres reportings réglementaires applicables.

Audits et contrôles réglementaires 

- Coordonner les audits externes, réglementaires et internes portant sur le contrôle interne, les risques opérationnels et la gouvernance. 

- Être le point de contact principal des auditeurs et des autorités compétentes sur les sujets de contrôle interne. 

- Gérer les demandes d’audit, la collecte des éléments justificatifs, le suivi des constats et les actions associées. 

- Coordonner la préparation et la mise en œuvre des plans d’actions correctifs et préventifs. 

- Suivre l’avancement des plans de remédiation et présenter les actions à risque élevé ou en retard aux instances de gouvernance appropriées. 

- Coordonner le programme de contrôle périodique et suivre sa mise en œuvre conformément au plan d’audit défini.

Externalisation, continuité d’activité et résilience opérationnelle 

- Garantir la robustesse et la bonne exécution du dispositif PSEE. 

- Contribuer au pilotage des activités externalisées et des prestataires tiers, conformément aux exigences réglementaires applicables. 

- Piloter les activités de continuité d’activité et de résilience opérationnelle de l’entreprise. 

- Maintenir et tester régulièrement les plans de continuité d’activité. 

- Participer aux exercices et aux réunions de gestion de crise lorsque cela est nécessaire. 

- Identifier les opportunités permettant de renforcer la résilience de Lemonway et sa capacité à maintenir ses activités critiques en cas de perturbation.

Politiques, procédures et formation 

- Évaluer les besoins de création ou de mise à jour des politiques, procédures, formulaires et documents de contrôle. 

- Coordonner la rédaction, la revue et la mise en œuvre des procédures de contrôle interne et de gestion des risques. 

- Concevoir ou contribuer à la création de supports de formation et de sensibilisation. 

- Veiller à ce que la documentation soit claire, opérationnelle, à jour et alignée avec le modèle de fonctionnement de l’entreprise. 

Expérience 

- Vous disposez d’au moins 8 ans d’expérience dans le contrôle interne, les risques opérationnels, l’ERM, l’audit, la conformité ou un domaine proche. 

- Vous avez évolué dans un environnement réglementé, idéalement dans le secteur du paiement ou en fintech. 

- Vous avez déjà encadré une équipe et travaillé sur la structuration ou la transformation d’un dispositif de gestion des risques et de contrôle interne. 

Compétences recherchées 

- Solide connaissance des dispositifs de contrôle interne et de gestion des risques opérationnels. 

- Bonne compréhension de l’environnement réglementaire français et européen, notamment des attentes de l’ACPR, des orientations de l’EBA, des exigences LCB-FT et de la DSP2. 

- Expérience du fonctionnement d’instances de gouvernance et de la préparation de reportings destinés à la Direction générale. 

- Maîtrise des environnements de transformation, de croissance ou de scale-up. 

- Expérience de la mise en place ou de l’évolution d’outils GRC. 

- Très bon niveau de français et d’anglais, à l’écrit comme à l’oral. 

- La connaissance de l’allemand ou d’une autre langue européenne constitue un atout.

Qualités personnelles 

- Leadership affirmé et bonnes compétences managériales. 

- Esprit structuré, rigoureux et grande capacité d’organisation. 

- Autonomie, tout en appréciant le travail collaboratif. 

- Approche pragmatique, orientée solutions et résultats. 

- Solides capacités d’analyse et grande attention aux détails. 

- Excellentes compétences en communication et en gestion des parties prenantes. 

- Capacité à challenger de manière constructive et à convaincre des interlocuteurs de tous niveaux. 

Avantages

title: Staff Backend Engineer, Integrations
description:
Streaming TV is no longer just a brand awareness channel. It’s becoming a core part of the performance marketing mix, alongside search and social. Vibe.co is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results.

Vibe.co is an Audience First Streaming TV Advertising platform that gives marketers the tools to reach the right audiences, optimize campaigns in real time, and understand what’s actually driving business outcomes. With hyper-targeted segmentation, AI-powered recommendations, real-time optimization, and incrementality measurement, Vibe brings the precision and accountability of digital advertising to the biggest screen in the house.

Today, more than 12,000 brands use Vibe.co to reach 120 million+ households. And in August 2026, Vibe.co became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta.

This is a unique moment to join Vibe. With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance-driven future for the channel.

About the Role

You'll join the Integrations team, the connective tissue of Vibe's platform, reporting to the Engineering Manager. The team owns everything flowing in and out of Vibe: measurement and attribution integrations, audience connections from CRMs and CDPs, and reporting pipelines.

This role exists because we're building a first-class Developer Platform: opening Vibe's full capabilities as a public API so external partners can build on top of us. Criteo is the first partner live on it.

Three reasons to want this:

- You'll be one of the most senior engineers on Integrations, setting technical direction for a team that's still small enough for one person's decisions to shape it

- You'll own the foundational architecture for a platform external partners are already building against

- AI-augmented development is the expectation here, not the experiment

What You'll Do

Build and ship integrations 

- Design and implement production-grade integrations with external platforms: CRMs, CDPs, measurement vendors, data partners

- Own integration projects end to end, from scoping through production, with full accountability for outcomes

- Work directly with external partners to define, validate, and evolve data contracts

Developer Platform 

- Drive the architecture of Vibe's public API: account, advertiser, and campaign management endpoints built to scale

- Build the documentation, monitoring, and tooling that makes the developer experience genuinely good

- Contribute to the MCP gateway and authentication layers that expose Vibe's capabilities externally

Reliability and scale 

- Find the weak points in existing pipelines and lead the rebuild

- Set the standard for code quality on the team: your reviews move the bar, not just the diff

- Use AI tooling to accelerate your own output and raise the team's

Technical leadership 

- Set engineering norms and technical direction as the Integrations team grows

- Weigh in on architecture decisions across the team, not just your own projects

- Partner with the Engineering Manager on technical direction and hiring calibration

What You Need

- 8+ years building production backend systems: APIs, data pipelines, distributed services at scale

- Strong TypeScript backend experience

- Direct ownership of a major project, start to finish, not just a contributor role on someone else's

- AWS and Terraform experience, with real architectural decision-making, not just implementation

- A high-ownership background: startup, scale-up, or anywhere you couldn't hand the hard problems to someone else

Nice to Haves

- Third-party integrations experience: ETL, webhooks, REST/GraphQL APIs

- Python/C++/Rust, alongside your TS work

- Experience designing or contributing to developer-facing platforms or public APIs

- Startup experience (~300 people or fewer), current or past. Doesn't need to be your most recent role

Our Values

At Vibe, we run on three values: Impact, Ambition, and Urgency. We tie every goal to a real business outcome, think 10x rather than settling for good enough, and move daily rather than waiting for perfect conditions.

title: CENTRALE LYON - PhD Silicon Photonics for Scalable Energy-Efficient AI Hardware Accelerators
description:
The rapid expansion of artificial intelligence (AI) applications across cloud and edge environments is driving the need for highly efficient hardware capable of supporting increasingly demanding workloads. Among these, matrix multiplication – particularly General Matrix Multiplication (GEMM) – remains the dominant computational kernel in modern AI models, including deep neural networks and transformer architectures. Conventional electronic accelerators, while highly optimized, face growing challenges related to energy consumption, data movement, and scalability. 

Silicon photonics has emerged as a promising technology to address these limitations by enabling highbandwidth, low-latency, and potentially energy-efficient computation through optical signal processing. In particular, recent advances in photonic computing leveraging phase-change materials (PCM) offer new opportunities for implementing reconfigurable and non-volatile computational primitives directly in the optical domain. 

This PhD is part of the CAMELIA program (ASIC and Numérique agencies) within the targeted project LEAF, and aims to explore a hybrid photonic–electronic computing paradigm for AI acceleration. The central objective is to design and evaluate silicon photonics-based architectures for efficient GEMM operations, building on recent work demonstrating a reconfigurable photonic GEMM architecture based on PCM and stochastic computing. 

The proposed research will focus on extending this tile-based photonic GEMM approach toward large-scale matrix operations under realistic conditions. Key challenges include managing PCM-related constraints such as limited precision and quantization effects, mitigating noise and variability, and addressing interface latency between photonic and electronic domains. 

A major aspect of the PhD will be the development of system-level evaluation and benchmarking methodologies within a design-technology co-optimization (DTCO/SDTCO) framework. The objective is to provide quantitative and objective metrics for decision-making, including scalability analysis, computational throughput, and energy efficiency for target AI workloads. These evaluations will support both intermediate design exploration and the potential experimental validation of fabricated demonstrators within the broader program. 

In addition, the PhD will address electronic circuit design challenges associated with photonic accelerators, including interface circuits for control, programming of PCM elements, optical-to-electrical readout, and signal conversion. These aspects are critical for ensuring the practical integration of photonic computing units within heterogeneous AI hardware systems. 

The expected outcome is a set of novel architectures, models, and evaluation tools that will clarify the potential and limitations of silicon photonics for next-generation AI accelerators, and provide guidelines for scalable and energy-efficient implementations.

Background: The candidate should hold or be about to obtain an MSc in Electronics Engineering, Photonics, or Computer Engineering. A strong background in computer architecture, integrated circuits, or photonic systems is expected. Knowledge of AI hardware accelerators, in-memory computing, or silicon photonics will be appreciated. 

Environment: The PhD will be carried out at the INL laboratory, within the CAMELIA program, as part of the LEAF project, in collaboration between leading academic and institutional partners in AI hardware and photonics. 

Starting dates: Fall 2026

Data quality is the bottleneck of the AI era. Every Fortune 500 is trying to solve it. We're the team they call.

Soda is the data quality layer for Disney, Ralph Lauren, CBRE, HelloFresh, 2K Games, and Nubank. The category is growing rapidly because AI doesn't work on bad data. Behind the product sits a group of three companies in two currencies, and a small finance team that keeps all of it correct. We're hiring a Finance & AI Automation Intern to run core finance processes and automate the manual work out of them.

About Us

Soda's mission is to monitor the world's decisions. We're building the first Data & AI performance monitoring platform that spans data collection to automated decision-making. Soda helps customers find, understand, and fix data quality issues by combining automated post-production monitoring with pre-production pipeline data testing.

Soda was founded in 2019 by Maarten (employee #5 at Collibra) and Tom (creator of multiple open-source projects generating hundreds of millions in value). We commercialize through Soda Cloud and we're well-funded, with investors like Point 9 Capital, Hummingbird, Singular, and Eurazeo.

The Role

You'll join the Finance team that covers Soda Data NV (Belgium), Soda Data Inc. (US) and NannyML NV, the Belgian company we acquired in 2025. The work is real from week one: invoice processing, month-end reporting, payroll data preparation, expense management, and intercompany recharges across three entities, two currencies and three accounting systems.

The second half of the job is making that work disappear. Finance at Soda builds agentically: Claude and other AI tools are part of the daily workflow, not an experiment on the side. You'll learn a process, run it until you know it cold, and then automate it. Sometimes that means an AI agent on GitHub, sometimes a well-designed formula - you pick the right tool and defend the choice. Accuracy is the bar for both: in finance, 99% right is wrong, so every automation ships with the checks and reconciliations that prove its output.

What You'll Do

- Run core finance processes: invoice processing, month-end reporting, payroll data preparation, expense management, and intercompany recharges. Learn them, run them, own them.
- Automate them: with Claude, ChatGPT, GitHub and the Soda MCP, or with smart spreadsheet design when that is the better tool.
- Build in the checks: reconciliations and controls in everything you automate, so the output is verified before anyone else has to look at it.
- Document as you go: process documentation that a colleague and an AI agent can both follow.
- Support the wider Finance team: reporting, analysis, and ad-hoc projects across our Belgian and US entities.

Hiring Process

1. Application with a few short questions

2. Recorded video interview (3 questions, in your own time)

3. 20-minute interview

4. Take-home assignment (plan for 5-6 hours)

5. 45-minute deep dive on your assignment

6. Final interview

We answer every application, and every candidate hears back within 3-5 days of each step. If it's not a hell yes, it's a no, and we'll tell you quickly and kindly.

Requirements 

• A finance background: studying towards or recently completed a degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field.

• Proof that you build: you've used AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) and/or built automations, scripts, or advanced spreadsheet solutions, and you can show us one and explain how you checked its output.

• Accuracy as a habit: you're the person who notices the 780 that should have been 800, and you don't sign off on numbers you haven't verified.

• Independent with new tools: you can pick up GitHub, MCP-based integrations, and finance systems without a course.

• Proactive: you spot the manual work and come with a plan for it. You'd rather build the workflow than do the task fifteen more times.

• Fluent English, written and spoken.

• European business hours: fully remote from any compatible time zone, or hybrid if you're near Amsterdam.

Good to Have

• Experience with accounting software (e.g. Exact Online, QuickBooks) or ERP systems.

• Exposure to Python, SQL, or API-based automation.

• Prior startup or fast-paced work experience.

Benefits 

What We Offer

• €1,250 - €1,750 per month, depending on experience.

• A clear path to a permanent role if you perform: 3-month contractor engagement first, extended as it works.

• Fully remote and flexible working, or hybrid if you're near Amsterdam.

• All the tokens you need, across all frontier models.

• Real ownership, real impact, no micromanagement. This is not a coffee-and-observe internship - you operate as part of the Finance team.

• Start: As soon as possible, aiming for the beginning of October 2026

Our Values

We value freedom with responsibility, transparency, and a growth mindset. We avoid politics, have no tolerance for dishonesty, and value open and direct communication without judgment. We proactively bring up and address potential issues before they become critical, and we overcommunicate frequently. Working at Soda, you will have full autonomy to make impactful product and roadmap decisions.

❤️ Why you will love to join Soda

• You own processes, not tickets: what you automate is yours to design, and behind it is a list of things nobody here has built yet.

• Be part of a transformation: data quality is having its moment, and we're at the front of it.

• Ownership from day one: if you see a bottleneck, you remove it.

• International culture: colleagues in 12+ countries.

• Work on your own terms: fully remote, flexible hours.

😡 What you might not love

• Rapidly changing priorities: our roadmap can pivot quickly. It's a fast-paced environment with a LOT of work to be done.

• Flexibility required: you will have to learn new things all the time.

Join us to elevate our finance team to the next level!

Your profile - Several years of experience in operations, supply chain, or logistics management, ideally in fashion, e-commerce, or retail 

- Track record of owning a function end-to-end, incl. inventory planning, demand forecasting, and cost/KPI frameworks 

- Strong affinity for AI and automation tools, with a genuine drive to make processes more efficient 

- Vision and clear understanding of what a state of the art operations set-up and process looks like 

- A true hands-on mentality — as comfortable executing as designing the process 

- Confident managing external partners and aligning cross-functional teams

- Full-time (100%), based in or around Munich (office option in Munich), but remote-first way of working 

Your benefits - Bootstrapped and long-term oriented start-up, allowing you to take responsibility and actively shape the growth path of ALEMI

- Remote-first working setup without core hours or face time

- Regular virtual and onsite team events 

- The latest IT and software set-up, e.g. Shopify, Claude, Notion, GetKLAR, Personio 

- Unlimited Claude Tokens to build your dream set-up (if justified)

title: Verkaufstalent Düsseldorf Airport flex (m/w/d)
description:
Als Verkaufstalent in unserer Boutique in Düsseldorf Airport (24–32 Stunden) bist du das Gesicht von My Jewellery. Du begrüßt Kund/-innen mit viel Begeisterung, gibst persönliche Styling-Tipps und sorgst dafür, dass jede Person die Boutique mit einem Lächeln verlässt. Gemeinsam mit deinem Team schaffst du eine inspirierende und einladende Atmosphäre im Store. Du sorgst dafür, dass die Boutique immer gepflegt aussieht und präsentierst die neuesten Kollektionen auf eine ansprechende Weise. Außerdem bekommst du viel Raum, dich in einem inspirierenden Umfeld weiterzuentwickeln.

Deine Aufgaben 

- Du unterstützt und berätst Kund/-innen und sorgst für persönlichen Service

- Du stellst sicher, dass die Boutique jederzeit die typische My Jewellery Atmosphäre ausstrahlt

- Du hältst die Boutique ordentlich, organisiert und visuell ansprechend

- Du bleibst immer up to date bei unseren Kollektionen und Trends

- Du unterstützt dein Team in Stoßzeiten und sorgst für eine positive

- Du bist enthusiastisch, kontaktfreudig und hast ein Gespür für Mode

- Du bist flexibel und kannst zwischen 24 und 32 Stunden pro Woche arbeiten

- Du bist bereit, sowohl unter der Woche als auch abends und am Wochenende zu arbeiten

- Du liebst den Kontakt mit Kund/-innen und denkst kommerziell

- Du arbeitest proaktiv und bringst gerne eigene Initiative ein

- Du wohnst in oder in der Nähe von Düsseldorf

Über My Jewellery 

My Jewellery wurde 2011 gegründet und zählt heute zu den am schnellsten wachsenden Marken- und E-Commerce Unternehmen der Niederlande, mit internationalem Wachstum. Wir entwickeln Kollektionen und Kampagnen, die das Leben unserer Community jeden Tag ein kleines bisschen schöner machen. Gemeinsam mit über 1.000 Kolleg/-innen bauen wir täglich an einer Marke voller Kreativität, Ambition und Persönlichkeit. 

Unsere Kultur? Persönlich, engagiert und lebendig. Bei uns kannst du ganz du selbst sein und bekommst den Raum, dich weiterzuentwickeln, zu lernen und wirklich etwas zu bewegen. Trotz unseres starken internationalen Wachstums bleiben die Kommunikationswege kurz, die Strukturen flach und der Teamspirit stark. Gemeinsam wollen wir jeden Tag einen Unterschied machen.

Your tasks

title: Cryogenics Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
Company Overview 

Focused Energy is the leading laser-driven fusion company, dedicated to creating clean, limitless fusion power. We unite top scientific and engineering talent to unlock commercially viable fusion energy using proven technologies. Our goal is to drive economic growth and scientific innovation through the adoption of clean, abundant fusion energy worldwide.

Your Role 

As a Cryogenics Engineer (f/m/d), you will play a pivotal role in designing, modeling, and optimizing advanced cryogenic thermal and fluid systems for commercial-scale fusion energy solutions. You will collaborate with interdisciplinary teams to develop, simulate, and validate experimental designs, helping define the roadmap toward efficient and scalable clean energy.

What You’ll Do 

- Own the end-to-end simulation and analysis function for cryogenic thermal and fluid systems—from problem definition through model development, validation, and continuous improvement.

- Lead analytical approaches for new and undefined challenges, applying first-principles research to create pioneering solutions.

- Drive model validation through close collaboration with experimental engineers, comparing simulation outputs to test data, and closing performance gaps.

- Ensure that the Cryo team’s hardware decisions are consistently supported by robust quantitative analysis.

- Develop integrated thermal and fluid analysis packages for commercial-scale system development, conducting optimization and sensitivity studies as needed.

- Continuously refine analysis models as new experimental, materials, and system data become available.

- Partner closely with hardware engineers, experimentalists, and scientists to define system requirements and deliver actionable analyses for design.

- Provide the analytical foundation for the Cryo team’s technical roadmap, guiding what gets built, tested, and scaled.

Who You Are 

- 3–5 years’ experience (or equivalent PhD research) in integrated thermal and fluid analysis involving cryogenic systems (experience with hydrogen is preferred).

- MSc or PhD in Mechanical Engineering, Physics, Chemical Engineering, or a related discipline.

- Strong foundation in heat transfer, thermodynamics, and fluid mechanics.

- Proficient in thermal analysis software (e.g., Thermal Desktop, COMSOL) and able to anchor analyses to real hardware.

- Familiarity with hydrogen systems, vacuum systems, cryogenic technologies, and phase change in solids, liquids, and gases.

- Skilled with instrumentation, sensors, and control logic for temperature, pressure, and flow in cryogenic environments.

- Hands-on experience with test rig construction, system debugging, and low-temperature measurements to support model validation is a plus.

- Comfortable collaborating across disciplines, and able to coordinate effectively with multiple engineering and science teams.

If you are excited about advancing clean energy and eager to make impact on a groundbreaking technology, we encourage you to apply.

title: Praktikum Fundraising und Campaigning
description:
Wir von GermanZero machen Deutschland klimaneutral – von unten. Oktober 2026.

- Du bist eine gute Teamplayer:in, behältst deine Aufgaben gut im Blick und bringst Interesse an digitalen Tools und Software-Lösungen mit. 

- Dir liegt der Klimaschutz am Herzen, und du möchtest andere Menschen für das Thema begeistern und gemeinsam etwas bewegen 

- Du willst zeigen, wie wichtig das Engagement durch Spenden und Fördermittel für gemeinnützige Organisationen ist.

Wir arbeiten daran, zukünftig Praktikant:innen zumindest eine Aufwandsentschädigung bezahlen zu können. Sobald das eine Option ist, werden wir diesen Text hier anpassen.

Remote-Arbeit ist möglich. Idealerweise suchen wir für diese Stelle eine Person, die in Berlin lebt und regelmäßig vor Ort sein kann. Wir suchen Praktikant:innen für einen Zeitraum von mindestens 3 Monaten mit 20-30 Stunden die Woche.

Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travelers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail, and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers, including Google Maps and Booking.com .

We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest-growing startups in travel, backed by leading venture capital investors including TQ Ventures, Lightrock, Creandum, and Northzone, and are headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond.

The Opportunity 

We are looking for an entrepreneurial Expansion Manager to focus on market expansion and build and scale Distribusion’s airport transfer operator network across Europe. This is a high-ownership role for someone who wants to build a business within a company. Working within Distribusion’s broader airport commercial strategy, you will own a clearly defined sub-segment end to end - from identifying attractive markets and securing operator partnerships to launching them and delivering measurable commercial growth.
You will have the opportunity to build the approach from scratch, deliver highly visible results and take on broader responsibility as the segment scales.

What you will do 

- Translate the broader airport strategy into a prioritised expansion plan , based on market potential, coverage gaps and clear business cases

- Build a repeatable market-entry playbook , incorporating market feedback and lessons from execution

- Originate, negotiate and close partnerships with airport transfer operators, supported by compelling and tailored commercial propositions

- Build senior relationships with operators, airports, airport authorities and relevant local partners to unlock market access and growth

- Coordinate internal team s through contracting, integration, launch and ramp-up

- Own post-launch commercial performance , identify gaps and drive corrective actions

Workplace: Berlin & Hybrid or Europe & Remote

Who you are: 

- You bring 2-3 years at a top-tier consulting firm, or 3-5 years in sales, business development, or a commercial role at a high-growth tech company.

- You have a track record of taking ownership of a commercial area and growing it: markets deepened, strategies sharpened, results delivered

- You can navigate product complexity and translate it into a compelling sales narrative; experience as a tech BD or sales engineer with full commercial cycle ownership is a strong signal

- Experience in a tech company, marketplace, or platform business is a strong advantage; B2B sales experience is a plus

- A background in consulting, or experience at a high-growth tech platform or fast-scaling startup, tells us a lot about your operating style

- You are self-driven, independent, and resourceful; you thrive with full ownership and minimal guidance

- You collaborate well in a matrixed environment and bring positive ambition to teams where others are also running their own markets

- Excellent negotiation, communication, and interpersonal skills

- You are fluent in English (spoken and written); an additional European language, French, German, or others, is a big plus

What you can expect: 

- Make a global impact. Help shape how millions of people discover and book ground transportation worldwide.

- Own your work. Take responsibility from day one and see the direct impact of your contributions.

- Build with the best tools. We move fast, continuously evolve our tech stack, and invest in modern, efficient solutions.

- Work with industry leaders. Our partners include Booking.com , Google Maps, Amtrak, Deutsche Bahn, Renfe, and SNCF.

- Grow with exceptional people. Join an international team that will challenge, support, and inspire you every day.

- Work your way. Enjoy flexible and remote-friendly working options, relocation opportunities, and plenty of room to grow.

enomyc – Wir gestalten den Mittelstand von morgen. 

Wenn Unternehmen in herausfordernde Situationen geraten, braucht es Erfahrung, Klarheit und Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen.

Für aktuelle und zukünftige Mandate bei mittelständischen Unternehmen bauen wir unser enomyc Interim Executive Network gezielt weiter aus und suchen erfahrene Chief Restructuring Officers (CRO) und Restrukturierungsmanager:innen , die Unternehmen in anspruchsvollen Transformations-, Turnaround- und Krisensituationen operativ begleiten.

Als Interim CRO arbeitest du eng mit unseren Partner:innen und Projektteams zusammen – und übernimmst beim Mandanten dort Verantwortung, wo schnelle Entscheidungen, belastbare Zahlen und konsequente Umsetzung gefragt sind.

Deine möglichen Mandate

Je nach Unternehmenssituation übernimmst du als CRO, Sanierungsmanager:in oder mit entsprechender Vollmacht Verantwortung für:

- Steuerung von Restrukturierungs- und Turnaround-Situationen im Mittelstand

- Entwicklung und konsequente Umsetzung von Sanierungs- und Maßnahmenprogrammen 

- Sicherstellung von Liquidität und Finanzierung 

- Steuerung integrierter Unternehmens- und kurzfristiger Liquiditätsplanungen

- Zusammenarbeit mit Banken, Finanzierungspartnern, Gesellschaftern und weiteren Stakeholdern

- Begleitung von IDW S6-, IBR- und ggf. insolvenznahen Situationen 

- Umsetzung operativer und finanzwirtschaftlicher Restrukturierungsmaßnahmen

- Führung von Managementteams und Steuerung kritischer Entscheidungsprozesse

- je nach Mandat Übernahme weitreichender operativer Verantwortung

Das bringst du mit

- Mehrjährige Erfahrung als CRO, Restrukturierungsmanager:in, CFO in der Krise oder Sanierungsberater:in 

- nachweisbare Restrukturierungs- und Turnaround-Erfahrung im deutschen Mittelstand 

- fundierte Erfahrung mit Liquiditätssteuerung, integrierter Planung und Finanzierung 

- Erfahrung im Umgang mit IDW S6 / IBR und den relevanten Stakeholdern einer Restrukturierung

- ausgeprägte Umsetzungsstärke – du analysierst nicht nur, sondern setzt Maßnahmen gemeinsam mit dem Unternehmen um

- souveräner Umgang mit Geschäftsführungen, Gesellschaftern, Banken und Finanzierungspartnern

- Bereitschaft zu einer substanziellen Vor-Ort-Präsenz beim Mandanten 

- Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau , sehr gute Englischkenntnisse

- kurzfristige bzw. projektbezogene Verfügbarkeit als selbstständige:r Interim Manager:in

Zusammenarbeit mit enomyc

Wir bieten dir keine klassische Freelancer-Börse, sondern die Möglichkeit, Teil unseres Interim Executive Networks zu werden.

Dich erwarten:

- anspruchsvolle Restrukturierungs- und Transformationsmandate im Mittelstand

- enge Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen enomyc Partner:innen und Beratungsteams

- klar definierte Mandate, Laufzeiten und Tagessätze

- Einbindung deiner operativen Expertise in unsere Beratungsmandate

- die Möglichkeit, auch in Interim-Teams gemeinsam mit weiteren Spezialist:innen Verantwortung zu übernehmen

- eine langfristige Zusammenarbeit über einzelne Mandate hinaus

Für ein schnelles Matching interessieren uns insbesondere deine aktuelle Verfügbarkeit, dein Tagessatz, deine Reisebereitschaft sowie ausgewählte Referenzmandate. 

Deine Ansprechpartnerin ist Anne Rienecker, Head of People Advisory .

Du übernimmst Verantwortung, wenn Unternehmen sie am dringendsten brauchen?

Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich für unser Interim Executive Network kennenzulernen.

title: Service Techniker:in Photovoltaik (f/m/x)
description:
Über uns 

Otovo ist ein führendes Unternehmen im Bereich erneuerbarer Energien, spezialisiert auf die Installation von Photovoltaik-Anlagen für Privathaushalte. Gegründet 2016 in Norwegen, sind wir heute in mehreren europäischen Ländern aktiv und seit 2021 auch in Deutschland tätig. Unser Ziel: Solarenergie für alle zugänglich, kosteneffizient und unkompliziert zu machen.

Otovo wurde gegründet, um ein einfaches, aber wichtiges Problem zu lösen: Hausenergiesysteme zuverlässig und sorgenfrei zu gestalten. Unser Team legt Wert auf Sicherheit, technische Exzellenz und exzellenten Kundenservice. Wir glauben, dass verlässliche Energie keine komplizierten Prozesse erfordern sollte.

Dafür bieten wir unseren Kunden einen Rundum-Service – von der Installation bis zur regelmäßigen Wartung – und sorgen dafür, dass Probleme schnell und effizient gelöst werden.

Deine Aufgaben 

- Diagnose, Wartung und Reparatur von Photovoltaik-Anlagen, Batteriesystemen, Ladestationen für Elektrofahrzeuge und zugehöriger elektrischer Komponenten

- Durchführung der regelmäßigen Wartung: Überprüfung von Verkabelung, Inverter, Batteriezustand, Funktionstests

- Inbetriebnahme und Updates von Anlagen (Commissioning): elektrische Konfigurationen, Erdungskontrollen, Inverter-Parameter, ATS-Tests von Generatoren

- Ausführung elektrischer Arbeiten, sowohl routinemäßig als auch außerplanmäßig

- Direkter Kundenkontakt: Fehlererklärung, Lösungsfindung, Follow-up

- Dokumentation: Einsatzberichte, Fotos, Checklisten, verwendetes Material

- Einsatzbereitschaft bei Notfällen und Bereitschaftsdienst

- Alle Tätigkeiten unter strikter Einhaltung der deutschen Normen (VDE 0100, VDE 0105, GSE-Prozesse angepasst auf deutsche Anforderungen)

Dein Profil 

- Abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung im Bereich Elektrotechnik oder vergleichbare Qualifikation

- Mindestens 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung im elektrischen Bereich, idealerweise mit direkter Erfahrung in Photovoltaik, Batteriesystemen oder Generatoren

- Zertifikate nach VDE 

- Fähigkeit, elektrische Schaltpläne zu lesen und professionelle Messtechnik sicher anzuwenden

- Kenntnisse der relevanten Normen und Vorschriften (VDE 0100, VDE 0105, GSE- und Netzbetreiber-Prozesse)

- Führerschein Klasse B und Bereitschaft zu täglichen Außeneinsätzen

- Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit mit Kunden und selbstständiges Arbeiten

- Fähigkeit, Lasten bis zu 25 kg zu heben

- Strikte Einhaltung der Sicherheitsvorschriften (DGUV, PSA)

- Zertifizierung für Arbeiten in der Höhe (optional, von Vorteil)

Was wir bieten 

- Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag

- Jahresgehalt zwischen 45.000 € und 65.000 € brutto, abhängig von Erfahrung und Qualifikation

- Essensgutscheine und Reisekostenerstattung

- Firmenfahrzeug

- Vollständige Arbeitskleidung und PSA

- Kontinuierliche Weiterbildung und Unterstützung bei Zertifizierungen (VDE, Hersteller-Updates)

- Dynamisches Arbeitsumfeld mit modernster Technologie und technischem Support

Chancengleichheit 

Wir begrüßen Bewerbungen von Menschen jeden Geschlechts (m/w/d) und achten auf Chancengleichheit gemäß deutschem Recht. Ein gültiger Arbeits- bzw. Aufenthaltstitel für die EU ist Voraussetzung.

title: Head of Public Affairs (Germany & EU) @ AI Infrastructure Venture, Dresden
description:
This is an Atlantic portfolio venture.

About the Venture 

We're building next-generation HPC and AI infrastructure for a world where brute-force compute is reaching its limits. Our chip and system architecture is designed to exploit sparsity at scale, focusing compute where it matters most and eliminating unnecessary computation everywhere else. That means orders-of-magnitude gains in performance and efficiency. We're based in Dresden and working at the intersection of deep tech, European industrial policy, and the global AI race.

About the Role 

This is a senior hire at the centre of how we engage with government, regulators, and the broader European policy landscape. You'll lead our public affairs strategy across Germany and the EU, shaping how we're positioned in some of the most consequential policy debates of the decade: AI, semiconductors, digital sovereignty, and high-performance computing. You'll work directly with the CEO and leadership team, with real ownership over how we show up in Berlin and Brussels.

What you'll do 

- Define and execute our public affairs strategy across German federal and regional government, and EU institutions in Brussels

- Monitor and anticipate regulatory, legislative, and geopolitical developments that affect our business

- Build and maintain relationships with policymakers, institutional partners, and government stakeholders

- Represent us in high-level meetings, consultations, and policy forums in Berlin and Brussels

- Position us as a recognised voice in European AI infrastructure and deep tech

- Engage with industry alliances, think tanks, and research institutions across Germany and the EU

- Identify and support access to public funding programmes, including Horizon Europe, the Chips Act, IPCEI, and national innovation programmes

- Drive participation in strategic consortia and collaborative European initiatives

- Develop policy narratives around AI, compute infrastructure, and European competitiveness

- Contribute to position papers, consultation responses, and public communications

- Support CEO and leadership visibility in policy and industry discussions

- Advise internally on regulatory risks and opportunities, helping align corporate strategy with the political landscape

About You 

You understand how policy gets made in Berlin and Brussels, and you know how to get a deep tech company into the right rooms. You're equally comfortable briefing a minister, drafting a position paper, or working with an engineering team to translate what we do into language that resonates with policymakers. You think strategically but you're hands-on, and you're motivated by the idea of shaping European technology policy from inside a company that's building something genuinely new.

- Significant experience in public affairs, government relations, or policy, with a strong track record across both Germany and EU institutions

- Background in deep tech, AI, semiconductors, or advanced computing

- An established network in Berlin and / or Brussels policy circles

- Experience working within or alongside startups or scale-ups, not just large corporates

- Able to translate complex technical topics into clear, accessible messaging for non-technical audiences

- Professional fluency in both English and German

Nice to have:

- Additional EU languages

- Experience with IPCEI processes or large-scale European consortium programmes

- Familiarity with German federal and regional funding landscapes

Why Join 

We're at an inflection point. The European policy environment around AI, semiconductors, and compute infrastructure is moving fast, and we're right in the middle of it. This role gives you direct influence over how a deep tech company engages with some of the most important policy debates in Europe today. You'll work closely with the CEO, have genuine ownership of the strategy, and help shape how Europe builds its compute future. We offer relocation support and a flexible, inclusive working environment.

title: Founder Associate (gn) @ AI Venture, Berlin
description:
This is an Atlantic portfolio venture.

About the Venture 

AI is being built into more products every month, and every interaction consumes tokens. As usage grows, the costs add up quickly. The first race was adoption. The next one is efficiency, because inference costs increasingly decide what companies can afford to build and ship. We are building the efficiency layer for production AI. Our systems make AI dramatically leaner, cutting token usage and lowering the cost of every interaction without giving up the quality standards that matter. We work with enterprise software companies, and we want to become a core part of the global AI ecosystem.

About the Role 

You will work directly with our founder and CEO on whatever matters most that week. A lot of it is commercial: working out who needs us, getting into conversations with them, understanding what they run and what it costs them. The rest is everything else that needs doing when a company is this young. We closed our pre-seed in 3 weeks and are now preparing our first customer pilots, so there is a lot of ground to cover and very few people to cover it. This is a rare seat for someone early in their career / you will see how a company gets built and you will build a good part of it yourself.

What you'll do 

- Work alongside the founder on the priorities that matter most, which will change as we grow.

- Research the market and help us work out who our best customers are and why.

- Build target lists, write outreach and get conversations started with technology and software companies in DACH.

- Join customer conversations, take notes that matter and turn what you hear into sharper positioning.

- Learn how customers run their AI workloads, what those workloads cost and the quality standards they need.

- Set up the tools, CRM and processes we need to keep track of customers as the volume grows.

- Use AI throughout your own work so a team of our size can cover far more ground.

- Prepare materials for customers, investors and partners.

- Pick up the unglamorous groundwork nobody else has got to yet.

About You 

We are looking for someone early in their career who learns quickly and takes on more than the title suggests. You will not have done most of this before, and that is fine. What matters is that you are curious about customers, comfortable without much structure, and inclined to work out the answer yourself before asking for it.

- You have spent some time in a startup, a venture fund, consulting or a commercial role, whether through a job, an internship or something you built yourself.

- You enjoy talking to people you have not met before and can hold your own with commercial and technical audiences alike.

- You write clearly and can turn messy input into something structured.

- You are comfortable with software and already use AI tools well in your own work.

- You are interested in AI infrastructure, developer tools or enterprise software, and can pick up a technical product quickly.

- You create structure from ambiguity and stay practical about what it takes to get results.

- Fluent English is required. Fluent German is a strong advantage.

Why Join 

You will join at the earliest stage, work next to the founder every day and watch decisions get made rather than hear about them later. The role is broad on purpose, so what you own will grow as fast as you do, with a clear path into a commercial or operating role as the team grows. The pace is high and the timelines are ambitious, and that asks a lot of everyone here. It suits someone who wants real responsibility early and is motivated by building something at speed.

This is a full-time role based in our Berlin office 5 days a week, with a start date as soon as possible.

title: SAP Procurement & Supply Chain Transformation Consultant - Life Sciences Germany
description:
SAP Procurement & Supply Chain Transformation Consultant – Life Sciences 

Are you ready to help Life Sciences organizations build resilient, compliant, and intelligent procurement functions that enable innovation, accelerate growth, and strengthen supply security?

About your role 

Infosys Consulting is seeking talented and highly motivated consultants to join our Life Sciences practice specializing in Procurement and Supply Chain Transformation.

As a SAP Procurement & Supply Chain Transformation Consultant, you will help pharmaceutical and biotechnology organizations transform procurement operating models, optimize supplier networks, and modernize Source-to-Pay processes through a combination of business consulting and digital technologies.

You will work with procurement, supply chain, manufacturing, quality, and IT stakeholders to improve operational efficiency, supplier performance, compliance, and business resilience. Combining business process expertise with SAP-enabled transformation capabilities, you will support clients across strategy, design, implementation, and value realization initiatives.

RESPONSIBILITIES 

Procurement Strategy and Transformation 

- Assess procurement operating models and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, compliance, supplier collaboration, and business value.
- Support procurement transformation initiatives across direct, indirect, and R&D-related spend categories.
- Design future-state procurement processes, governance models, and organizational capabilities.
- Develop business cases and transformation roadmaps aligned with client objectives.
Source-to-Pay Process Excellence 

- Analyze and optimize Source-to-Contract, Procure-to-Pay, Supplier Management, and Category Management processes.
- Identify opportunities to leverage automation, analytics, AI, and digital procurement capabilities.

title: Chemical Laboratory Assistant / Lab Technician (f/m/d) Analytics & Synthesis
description:
Your mission Join aevoloop, a deep-tech startup in Leipzig, where we are pioneering the next generation of circular plastics. We are looking for a hands-on Chemical Technical Assistant (CTA) or Lab Technician who takes pride in their lab work. In this role, your primary focus will be on the precise "measuring" (analytics) of our materials, while reliably supporting the team with "making" (synthesis).

- Analytics & Characterization: You are the analytical core of our lab. You routinely perform instrumental and wet-chemical analyses to precisely characterisze our next-generation materials (e.g., NMR, IR spectroscopy, DSC, titrations).

- Synthesis Execution: You support syntheses (specifically polycondensations) on a bench and pilot scale, reliably and accurately executing reactions according to established standard operating procedures (SOPs).

- Daily Lab Routine & Excellence: You ensure smooth lab operations. This includes preparing and maintaining glassware, sample preparation, material drying, and general lab organization.

- Precision & Documentation: You ensure our measurement data is rock-solid. This includes regular calibration of analytical instruments, maintaining detailed lab journals, and assisting in drafting clear SOPs.

- Safety & Organization: You maintain a safe, high-standard working environment (GLP) and ensure analytical equipment is always ready for the next run.

Your profile - Education: Successfully completed vocational training as a CTA (Chemical Technical Assistant), Chemielaborant, or a similar technical background. Academic degrees or Techniker qualifications are considered, but this is a hands-on technical role where practical bench experience is our top priority.

- Analytical Expertise: Strong practical experience in general instrumental and wet-chemical analytics (especially NMR, IR, DSC, titration). Experience in specialized polymer testing (e.g., MFR/MFI, tensile testing) or prior experience in a plastics laboratory is a major plus!

- Synthesis Experience: Experience in carrying out organic syntheses safely according to protocol (SOPs). Specialized knowledge of polymers or reactors is advantageous, but not mandatory—we are happy to train you.

- Technical Routine: You feel "at home" in the lab. You are confident operating analytical instruments, preparing samples, and performing routine instrument calibrations.

- Mindset: You bring a "maker" mentality. You are detail-oriented, reliable, and enjoy the dynamic, collaborative energy of a scaling startup.

- Languages: Working knowledge of English (sufficient for technical documentation and day-to-day team communication) is required. German is a plus, but not necessary.

Why us? - Real Impact: Help redesign plastics for a truly circular economy. 
- Startup Mindset: Flat hierarchies, fast decisions and early responsibility as we scale. 
- Team Culture: Join a team of curious minds that challenge each other, collaborate openly and celebrate progress together. 
- Growth & Learning: Steep learning curves, regular feedback and room to grow with the company. 
- Well-being Perks – Hansefit membership and fresh snacks and beverages your overall health and well-being.

title: Senior PR Manager (m/w/d) – Remote oder Berlin
description:
Overview PR steht vor einem strukturellen Bruch. Vertrauen verschiebt sich, Sichtbarkeit wird neu verteilt, KI wächst exponentiell. Wir bei getpress glauben, dass Reputation in den nächsten zehn Jahren der entscheidende Wettbewerbsvorsprung für Unternehmen wird. Und dass die Agentur, die das ernst nimmt, anders aussehen muss als die Agentur von gestern. 
Deshalb bauen wir die PR Company der Zukunft . Outcome-getrieben statt Retainer-Stunden. KI-first statt KI-on-top. Automatisiert, wo es skaliert und menschlich, wo es wirklich zählt. Unser über 40 köpfiges Team aus Journalist*innen und PR-Strateg*innen hat seit 2017 die PR für 450+ der spannendsten Wachstumsunternehmen Europas gesteuert – und hat Hunger auf mehr. 
Bist du dabei? 

Deine Rolle - Strategisch und themensicher: Du entwickelst individuelle PR Strategien für Kunden aus dem B2B- und B2C-Bereich – mit klarem Fokus auf Themenplatzierung in relevanten Medien. Dabei bringst du journalistisches Denken und strategische Kommunikation zusammen. 
- Beratend auf Augenhöhe: Du steuerst die Kommunikation mit deinen Kund*innen professionell, planst vorausschauend (z. B. mit Quartalsplänen & KPIs) und baust langfristige Beziehungen auf. Du bringst proaktiv Themen ein – und entwickelst die Kommunikation deiner Kund*innen kontinuierlich weiter. Du bist Sparringspartner*in auf C-Level-Augenhöhe, nicht Auftragsempfänger*in. 
- Teamorientiert & offen: Du teilst dein Wissen, gibst und nimmst Peer-to-Peer-Feedback über alle Erfahrungslevel hinweg, ohne Gatekeeping, mit echtem Interesse an gemeinsamer Weiterentwicklung. 
- Vorne auf der AI Welle: Du arbeitest aktiv mit unserem internen AI-Stack. Recherche, Pitch-Vorbereitung, Themen-Scouting – wo Maschinen schneller sind, lassen wir sie machen. Du investierst die gewonnene Zeit in Substanz, Beziehungen und Kreativität. 
- Aktives Netzwerken: Du baust und pflegst belastbare Beziehungen zu Journalist*innen aus den wichtigsten Medien im DACH Raum und Europas. 

Wer du bist - 4+ Jahre Erfahrung in der operativen PR, idealerweise im Agenturumfeld, und hast Kund*innen nachweislich eigenständig in deutschen Leit- und Fachmedien platziert. 
- Du bringst fundierte Beratungskompetenz mit, analysierst Zielgruppen und Märkte, übersetzt Unternehmensziele in PR Strategien, leitest messbare Maßnahmen ab und begleitest deine Kund*innen als verlässliche* Sparringspartner*in auf Augenhöhe. 
- Du hast ein belastbares Netzwerk zu Journalist*innen und weißt, wie man vertrauensvolle Beziehungen aufbaut und pflegt. 
- Du beobachtest die Nachrichtenlage aktiv und erkennst Themenpotenziale, bevor andere sie auf dem Schirm haben. 
- Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, bringst dich ins Team ein und teilst dein Wissen offen. 
- Du nutzt KI-Tools pragmatisch, um Prozesse zu beschleunigen, damit mehr Zeit für inhaltliche Tiefe und kreative Ideen bleibt. 
- Du sprichst Deutsch auf C2- Niveau, kannst auch auf Englisch professionell kommunizieren und lebst in Deutschland 

Was dich erwartet - Journalistische PR statt Massenversand: Bei uns gibt es keine generischen Pressemitteilungen oder Gießkannenverteiler. Wir arbeiten individuell, redaktionell und mit klarer Themenstrategie und pitchen gezielt per Telefon bei passenden Journalist*innen aus einem breiten Medienspektrum. 
- Langfristige Perspektive & Entwicklung: Du startest mit einem unbefristeten Vertrag. Gemeinsam entwickeln wir einen klaren Fahrplan für deine fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung – mit regelmäßigen Feedbacks und transparenten Zielen. 
- Flexibilität, die wirklich gelebt wird: Ob remote (innerhalb Deutschlands), hybrid oder im Berliner Office – wir ermöglichen Arbeitsmodelle, die sich mit deinem privaten und beruflichen Leben gut vereinbaren lassen. Entscheidungsfreiheit, Eigenverantwortung und klare Kommunikation gehören für uns selbstverständlich dazu. 
- Unterstützung und offene Arme: Wir begegnen einander auf Augenhöhe – offen, ehrlich und mit echtem Interesse am Gegenüber. Wir lernen voneinander, geben einander Rückhalt und feiern gemeinsame Erfolge. 
- Eine Kultur von Challengern. Wir arbeiten ergebnisgetrieben, feiern Erfolge und erwarten, dass du uns challenged – und wir challengen zurück. Augenhöhe heißt bei uns: ehrliches Feedback in beide Richtungen. 
- Eine Lernkurve, die du anderswo nicht bekommst. Du arbeitest täglich mit einem Team, das das fortschrittlichste AI PR System im Markt baut. Wer sich jetzt einbringt, baut sich ein Profil, das in der Branche selten ist. 
- Benefits und Sweet Treats: Du kannst aus drei frei wählbaren Sachbezügen wählen, von einer betrieblichen Altersvorsorge mit 20% Zuschuss auf deine Einzahlungen profitieren,180 Tage im Jahr aus dem EU Ausland arbeiten, dich auf regelmäßige Teamevents freuen. Und das Beste: Du startest mit 27 Urlaubstagen aber je länger du bei uns bist, desto mehr Urlaubstage bekommst du dazu. 

Unser nächsten Schritte Wenn du jetzt denkst: ,,Klingt nach mir!’’ , dann bewirb dich ohne Anschreiben bei uns und wer weiß, vielleicht bist du schon schneller als gedacht Teil unseres getpress-Teams!

Wir setzen uns für Chancengleichheit ein und begrüßen Bewerbungen von Menschen unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Religion, sexueller Orientierung, Alter oder Behinderung. 

Wir freuen uns dich kennenzulernen! 
Dein People & Culture Team

title: Generative Media Engineer, AI Social - US
description:
Luxury Presence is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 90,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business.

The Opportunity 

AI Social is one of the most ambitious products we've ever shipped. An AI agent that produces on-brand Instagram carousels and reels for every Luxury Presence customer, from raw input data to finished media. It isn't LLMs writing code. It's LLMs designing, choosing the photo, voicing the script, picking the cuts, and composing the final frame.

As the Generative Media Engineer on AI Social , you own the render pipeline, the prompts and agent loops that drive it, and the visual quality of what ships. Product and content strategy partners set the direction; engineering and design peers ship alongside you. This is an unusual role at the intersection of code, design, AI, and social media. You don't fit the normal engineering mold, that's the point.

Skills and experience 

- Solid working knowledge of TypeScript and Node.js. You're comfortable shipping production code and you're ready to grow into our stack.

- Hands-on experience with LLM-driven systems. Prompts, structured outputs, tool-calling, agent loops, evals.

- At least one shipped piece of generative media in image, video, voice, or music that someone other than you has seen and used.

- A portfolio or body of work that demonstrates both technical depth and design sensibility.

- Bonus: a personal creator practice somewhere. A feed, a portfolio, a side project, a YouTube channel, an Are.na . Public, ongoing, under your own name. You understand the medium because you've lived in it.

- Formal or self-taught grounding in design, visual art, film, or motion.

- Comfort moving between exploratory PoC work and shipped-to-customers polish, with judgment about which mode is appropriate when.

Technical fluency with AI tools 

- You're already using Claude Code, Cursor, or similar AI-assisted development tools in your daily workflow. We're a Claude Code shop and we expect you to be fluent.

- Familiarity with MCPs and how tools like Figma, Notion, and Linear connect into AI-assisted workflows. You understand how these tools and integrations fit together and can help the team get more out of them.

- Beyond fluency, you're a dabbler and experimenter. You try new prompts, push their limits, and share what you learn. You have opinions about where the medium is headed.

Mindset 

- You're a tinkerer. You don't just build what's asked; you spot leverage points and build what's needed.

- You care about systems more than features. You'd rather build a template family that ships ten posts well than ten bespoke posts that age out by next week.

- You build on shared systems. Constraints feel like leverage, not obstacles.

- You have strong convictions about quality, but you ship. You know the difference between polish that matters and perfection that stalls.

- You partner well with non-engineers. You'll collaborate across product, design, and content strategy. Patience and clarity with people outside engineering is non-negotiable.

- You operate with high ownership and low ego. You take direction from product and strategy partners on what to build, and you raise the bar on everything you ship.

What You Won't Be Doing 

To be clear about what this role is not:

- You won't own platform architecture or distributed systems work. You'll partner with engineering teams that do, while you stay focused on the AI Social pipeline itself.

- You won't own the social strategy. You'll have a real voice in shaping it, but the call sits with our product and content strategy partners.

- You won't be managing people on day one. This is a hands-on IC role with the expectation that you lead through craft and influence.

Tech stack 

- Platform: Node, TypeScript, React, Postgres, AWS, Temporal

- LLMs and agents: the major model SDKs, with tool-calling, structured outputs, and multi-step agent loops

- Media pipeline: image and video generation (Veo for video), voice and music synthesis (ElevenLabs), composite (Shotstack), and headless browser rendering

Compensation

Additional Information

Join us in shaping the future of real estate 

The real estate industry is in the midst of a seismic shift, and the future belongs to those who break new ground. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the proptech and marketing sectors, Luxury Presence challenges the status quo of what technology can do for real estate agents, leaders, and brokerages.

We're a team of agile and tenacious innovators working collaboratively to drive the industry forward. Together, we build game-changing products that empower modern real estate entrepreneurs to dominate their markets. From award-winning web design to agile SEO solutions to cutting-edge AI tools, we deliver tech that anticipates market shifts and keeps our clients ahead of their competition.

Founded in 2016 by Stanford Business School alum Malte Kramer, Luxury Presence has grown to a global team ranked on the Inc. 5000 fastest-growing companies list three years in a row. We're backed by world-class investors, including Bessemer Venture Partners, NextEquity Partners, Toba Capital, and Switch Ventures, and have raised $89 million to date.

More than 18,000 real estate businesses rely on our platform, including 30% of the Wall Street Journal RealTrends top agents and teams. Additionally, many of the industry's most powerful brokerages rely on Luxury Presence as a trusted business partner.

Every year since 2020, Luxury Presence has ranked on BuiltIn's Best Place to Work lists. HousingWire named our founder and CEO a 2024 Tech Trendsetter, we've received several Tech100 Awards, and we just scored an Inman Innovation Award for Best AI-Powered Platform.

Luxury Presence is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin.

title: Principal Engineer TL/M - Software Development (PaaS)
description:
WHO WE ARE: 

Aviatrix® is pioneering the Cloud Native Security Fabric — the architecture the Containment Era requires. The Cloud Native Security Fabric governs every workload communication path across every cloud, every VPC, every Kubernetes cluster, and every serverless function, from a single policy plane. One rule. Universal propagation. Enforced at the workload, not at a chokepoint. Trusted by more than 500 of the world's leading enterprises. For more information, visit aviatrix.ai .

ABOUT THE ROLE: 

Aviatrix Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) delivers the intelligence, advanced network and security services of Aviatrix’s multi-cloud network platform as a managed offering.

We are seeking a hands-on Principal Engineer TL/M - Software Development to join our PaaS team. In this role, you will lead a team of engineers while also contributing to technical execution — defining designs, driving key features, and writing code alongside your team. You will balance engineering leadership with individual technical contributions, owning both people management responsibilities and product components. This is a Tech Lead/Manager (TL/M) role built for a builder who wants to grow as a people leader without leaving the craft behind.

Position Responsibilities: 

- Define and drive next-generation designs for complex distributed systems using Kubernetes and cloud services (AWS, Azure, GCP), contributing directly to code and architecture alongside your team.

- Own the end-to-end lifecycle (requirements, design, delivery, and operations) of key features of the PaaS product; break down large projects into executable sub-projects distributed across the team.

- Evaluate key engineering tradeoffs and make data-driven technical decisions that balance velocity, quality, and scalability.

- Write and present design proposals and technical documents that define complex problems and long-term solutions.

- Lead, mentor, and develop a small team of engineers; oversee hiring, career development, and performance management.

- Contribute to interviewing and recruiting efforts to attract and retain top engineering talent.

- Partner with product management to translate business priorities into a clear technical roadmap and execution plan.

- Foster a culture of accountability, technical excellence, diversity, equity, and respect.

- Represent the team in cross-functional forums, collaborating across engineering, product, and go-to-market functions.

Requirements 

- 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, including hands-on contributions to large-scale distributed systems.

- 3+ years in engineering leadership roles, with direct experience managing engineers and driving team outcomes.

- Strong knowledge of Golang and building gRPC-based microservices.

- Deep experience with Kubernetes and cloud services (AWS, Azure, GCP).

- Domain experience in network routing and network security.

- Experience designing and operating a PaaS/SaaS product at scale.

- Strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, operating systems, and distributed systems.

- Strong understanding of elegant and robust API and system designs.

- Ability to write clean, testable, and maintainable code and hold a high bar for the team.

- Proven ability to deliver results in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

- Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills; comfortable working with a geographically distributed team.

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

US Pay Range 

The annual base salary range for this full-time position is $249,019 - $292,963 + benefits + 401(k) match + equity and is bonus eligible. The pay range is determined by the role, work location, job-related skills, level, experience and relevant education. The range displayed is applicable only for new hires for the listed position located in the US. Your Talent Advisor can share more details regarding salary ranges, benefits, and equity for your location during the hiring process.

#LI-RACHEL #LI-Remote

BENEFITS 

US : We cover 100% of employee premiums and 88% of dependent(s) premiums for medical, dental and vision coverage, 401(k) match, short and long-term disability, life/AD&D insurance, $1,000/year education reimbursement, and a flexible vacation policy. 

Outside the US: We offer a comprehensive benefits package which, (subject to regional variations) could include pension, private medical for you and dependents, generous holiday allowance, life assurance, long-term disability, annual wellbeing stipend

Your total compensation package will be based on job-related knowledge, education, certifications and location, per our aligned ranges.

About Aviatrix  
Aviatrix® is the cloud network security company trusted by more than 500 of the world’s leading enterprises. As cloud infrastructures become more complex and costly, the Aviatrix Cloud Network Security platform gives companies back the power, control, security, and simplicity they need to modernize their cloud strategies. Aviatrix is the only secure networking solution built specifically for the cloud, that ensures companies are ready for AI and what’s next. Combined with the Aviatrix Certified Engineer (ACE) Program , the industry’s leading secure multicloud networking certification, Aviatrix unifies cloud, networking, and security teams and unlocks greater potential across any cloud.​

title: Engineering Manager, Maps & Search - US
description:
Luxury Presence is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 90,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business.

The Opportunity 

We don't just use AI. We build with it, ship with it, and think with it. With a generous budget for tokens, our engineers use AI agents to write, review, and ship production code every day. We are building toward a world where humans design systems and AI builds them, and we are already far along that path.

We are hiring a hands-on Engineering Manager to lead Maps & Search . This team owns the home search experience across web and mobile. It's one of the most visible, highest-traffic surfaces–the search service alone handles a billion requests every month .

This is a role for a manager who leads from the front: someone who still lives in their terminal with AI, has strong opinions about how AI changes the SDLC, and wants to amplify what a small, senior, AI-augmented team can accomplish. You will set technical direction, stay close to the code, and help the team produce consistent impact.

What You'll Do 

Lead and grow the Maps & Search team. Own hiring, onboarding, coaching, 1:1s, direct feedback, and career development. Treat management as a craft and build a healthy, high-performing team that ships impactful changes.

Stay hands-on. Contribute directly — code and design reviews, architecture, thorny debugging— and stay technical enough to make smart calls on trade-offs.

Own and scale a high-throughput search platform. Drive the architecture, relevance, latency, and reliability of a real estate search system handling ~1B monthly requests and hundreds of millions of listings.

Deliver a world-class home search experience. Own the core home discovery experience across web and mobile — improving engagement, lead conversion, and agent workflows while keeping interactions fast and responsive at scale.

Push forward AI-powered discovery. Partner across teams to bring LLMs and intelligent ranking into search and user workflows, improving how buyers and agents discover, filter, and engage with listings.

Shape the roadmap with product and design. Define what we build and why , not just focusing on the how . Translate user needs and business goals into a clear technical plan, and own delivery end to end — planning, quality, reliability, and incident response.

What We're Looking For 

Attributes 

- 
You lead from the front. You're still close to the code and technically respected, and you treat management as a craft — growing engineers, giving clear feedback, and building a team that ships.

- 
You already build with AI daily. You use AI as a core part of your workflow, not as a novelty — and you expect your team to as well.

- 
You have strong opinions, loosely held , about how AI changes software architecture, team structure, and engineering culture.

- 
You think in systems. You connect technical decisions to customer outcomes and business value.

- 
You communicate clearly and directly. You can explain complex tradeoffs to product, design, and executive stakeholders.

- 
You're energized by ambiguity and speed. You thrive in a fast-growing company where the roadmap evolves and ownership is real.

- 
You like to have fun at work. We take our craft seriously, but we don't take ourselves too seriously. We celebrate wins, crack jokes, and genuinely enjoy building together.

Skills and Experience 

- 
8+ years of professional software engineering experience with meaningful senior or staff-level time, plus 2+ years managing engineering teams.

- 
Search experience — you've worked on search, relevance, ranking, or retrieval systems. It doesn't have to be OpenSearch or Elasticsearch specifically, but you understand how search works and how to make it better.

- 
Deep expertise in TypeScript, Node.js, and React, with the full-stack fluency to reason about the whole request path from UI to data.

- 
Experience designing and operating scalable microservice architectures in cloud-native environments (AWS preferred).

- 
Strong understanding of GraphQL, event-driven systems (Kafka), and databases (PostgreSQL, OpenSearch).

- 
A proven track record operating high-traffic, low-latency production systems at scale — SLOs, incident response, and capacity planning are second nature.

- 
Experience leading high-impact initiatives from concept through production in a SaaS environment.

Tech Stack 

- 
Frontend: React, Tailwind, Apollo

- 
Backend: Node.js / TypeScript microservices

- 
Data: PostgreSQL, OpenSearch

- 
Infrastructure: AWS, Kubernetes, Lambda

- 
Messaging: Kafka, Redis

Compensation

Additional Information

Join us in shaping the future of real estate 

The real estate industry is in the midst of a seismic shift, and the future belongs to those who break new ground. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the proptech and marketing sectors, Luxury Presence challenges the status quo of what technology can do for real estate agents, leaders, and brokerages.

We're a team of agile and tenacious innovators working collaboratively to drive the industry forward. Together, we build game-changing products that empower modern real estate entrepreneurs to dominate their markets. From award-winning web design to agile SEO solutions to cutting-edge AI tools, we deliver tech that anticipates market shifts and keeps our clients ahead of their competition.

Founded in 2016 by Stanford Business School alum Malte Kramer, Luxury Presence has grown to a global team ranked on the Inc. 5000 fastest-growing companies list three years in a row. We're backed by world-class investors, including Bessemer Venture Partners, NextEquity Partners, Toba Capital, and Switch Ventures, and have raised $89 million to date.

More than 18,000 real estate businesses rely on our platform, including 30% of the Wall Street Journal RealTrends top agents and teams. Additionally, many of the industry's most powerful brokerages rely on Luxury Presence as a trusted business partner.

Every year since 2020, Luxury Presence has ranked on BuiltIn's Best Place to Work lists. HousingWire named our founder and CEO a 2024 Tech Trendsetter, we've received several Tech100 Awards, and we just scored an Inman Innovation Award for Best AI-Powered Platform.

Luxury Presence is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin.
